a17b5c2cd751b25b2d29985333fc0187b6b6356d.en: Yellow is considered as the most optimistic color.
a17b5c2cd751b25b2d29985333fc0187b6b6356d.zh: 黄色被认为是最具乐观主义色彩的颜色。

b62761fb092cefc36308fe5fbe1ddeb62fb165b5.en: Yet surprisingly, people lose their tempers more often in yellow rooms and babies cry more in them.
b62761fb092cefc36308fe5fbe1ddeb62fb165b5.zh: 然而令人惊讶的是，人们在黄色房间里更容易发脾气，婴儿也更容易哭闹。

b8e015970411cb090cbeacd325b82895903ac704.en: The reason may be that yellow is the hardest color for eyes to take in.
b8e015970411cb090cbeacd325b82895903ac704.zh: 原因可能是黄色是眼睛最难适应的颜色。

116a43e4f64f68e2617ae5c319fb3683f420e06b.en: So it can be overpowering if overused.
116a43e4f64f68e2617ae5c319fb3683f420e06b.zh: 因此，如果过度使用，它会显得过于强烈。

d580f43e88345cdb7d8f4a1da8621d0444703db0.en: The elephant is the largest living land mammal.
d580f43e88345cdb7d8f4a1da8621d0444703db0.zh: 大象是最大的现存陆地哺乳动物。

b591c6697f97c8c483911c78a17d57457ca4b991.en: During evolution, its skeleton has greatly altered from the usual mammal, designed for two main reasons.
b591c6697f97c8c483911c78a17d57457ca4b991.zh: 在进化过程中，它的骨骼结构发生了巨大变化，以适应两个主要原因。

f99b216eaf1efaf6521c936f518e41f640f1dc13.en: One is to cope with the great weight of huge grinding cheek teeth and elongated tusk, making the skull particularly massive.
f99b216eaf1efaf6521c936f518e41f640f1dc13.zh: 其中之一是为了承受巨大的咀嚼齿和长牙的重量，使头骨特别厚重。

61685475a308456ccc4651175634852261b482ea.en: The other is to support the enormous bulk of such a huge body.
61685475a308456ccc4651175634852261b482ea.zh: 另一个是为了支撑如此庞大身躯的巨大重量。

b9f9b039f7c024d7b227a348d4d964de37b14136.en: Market research is a vital part of the planning of any business.
b9f9b039f7c024d7b227a348d4d964de37b14136.zh: 市场调研是任何企业规划中至关重要的一部分。

f5f05217df29fd328ad4dce764db03286e810b69.en: However experienced you or your staff may be in a particular field, if you are thinking of introducing a service to a new area, it is important to find out what the local population thinks about it first.
f5f05217df29fd328ad4dce764db03286e810b69.zh: 无论您或您的员工在某个领域多么经验丰富，如果您打算将某项服务引入新地区，首先了解当地民众对此的看法至关重要。

b6fc036ceb6158336698953db9359b54ece23f22.en: Teenage girls are continuing to outperform boys in English while the gender gap in achievements in math and science has almost disappeared.
b6fc036ceb6158336698953db9359b54ece23f22.zh: 女中学生继续在英语学科上超越男生，而数学和科学领域的性别成绩差距几乎已经消失。

ea41292dfb5cbfeaf5e66c5e6505420b592af583.en: The figures show that last year 80% of 14-year-old girls reached at least the expected level 5 in English, compared with 65% of boys.
ea41292dfb5cbfeaf5e66c5e6505420b592af583.zh: 数据显示，去年80%的14岁女生在英语方面达到了至少5级的预期水平，而男生的这一比例为65%。

022e34d7ebbfbebd7499e9eff8054fdada380da5.en: But in math, the girls are just 1% ahead of boys, while in science the difference is 2%.
022e34d7ebbfbebd7499e9eff8054fdada380da5.zh: 但在数学方面，女生的优势仅比男生高出1%，而在科学方面，这一差距为2%。

998b3e27c9637a305f35b76dc861acf96ff3f33a.en: Hundreds of millions of American people eat fast food every day without giving it too much thought, unaware of the subtle and not so subtle ramifications of their purchases.
998b3e27c9637a305f35b76dc861acf96ff3f33a.zh: 数以亿计的美国人每天吃快餐而不假思索，并未意识到他们的消费行为所带来的微妙乃至不微妙的影响。

b02e96fa3ee3972e442804b38765f0bc37a22eec.en: They just grab their tray off the counter, find a table, take a seat, unwrap the paper, and dig in.
b02e96fa3ee3972e442804b38765f0bc37a22eec.zh: 他们只是从柜台上拿起托盘，找张桌子坐下，拆开包装纸，便开始大快朵颐。

61ca92e207065b7aa3d5bb48a8b4bd79785ce9d5.en: The whole experience is transitory and soon forgotten.
61ca92e207065b7aa3d5bb48a8b4bd79785ce9d5.zh: 整个过程转瞬即逝，很快就被遗忘。

d4a379c36b90f5ca5f9d0548f9d502acb886b06e.en: Your body is nearly two-thirds water.
d4a379c36b90f5ca5f9d0548f9d502acb886b06e.zh: 你的身体约三分之二由水组成。

b2e93bf3fe7c9244a66b79beb0378ac7163b9fad.en: And so it is really important that you consume enough fluid to stay hydrated and healthy.
b2e93bf3fe7c9244a66b79beb0378ac7163b9fad.zh: 因此，摄入足够的水分以保持水合状态和健康确实非常重要。

c8b47bfcb55025ce51faac03525a815ef5b5fbe0.en: If you don't get enough fluid you may feel tired, get headaches, and not perform at your best.
c8b47bfcb55025ce51faac03525a815ef5b5fbe0.zh: 如果水分摄入不足，你可能会感到疲劳、头痛，并且无法发挥最佳表现。

6e0efca3ea25105e530135a78a93b6947e2a4b3c.en: A study found that the research funded by the soft drinks industry had different results from research funded by other sources and went on to suggest that they may have been biased by the research itself.
6e0efca3ea25105e530135a78a93b6947e2a4b3c.zh: 一项研究发现，由软饮料行业资助的研究结果与其他来源资助的研究结果不同，并进一步指出这些研究可能存在偏见。

2194a64540d200d70187d3390d5ebb38f0bce001.en: The whole point of the scientific methods is to ensure the research results are not influenced by the source of funding.
2194a64540d200d70187d3390d5ebb38f0bce001.zh: 科学方法的核心宗旨是确保研究结果不受资金来源的影响。

a39afb0f4858b36ca21a32e5d5850b48b59ae14f.en: Imagine living all your life as the only family on your street.

7552afd3f6e070fb285deded00cca284af6c454c.en: Then, one morning, you open the front door and discover houses all around you.
7552afd3f6e070fb285deded00cca284af6c454c.zh: 然后，有一天早上，你打开前门，发现周围到处都是房屋。

287a435e946169e73ce7c76ccc8d9c2d751b3c4a.en: You see neighbors tending their gardens and children walking to school.
287a435e946169e73ce7c76ccc8d9c2d751b3c4a.zh: 你看到邻居们在打理花园，孩子们去上学。

b658444dd7474faf3bbe29ff48569f05d1e52a3f.en: Where did all the people come from?
b658444dd7474faf3bbe29ff48569f05d1e52a3f.zh: 这些人都是从哪里来的？

76820f62f9a8af3d4382e2a1f217ebf61c328db7.en: What if the answer turned out to be that they had always been there, you just hadn't seen them.
76820f62f9a8af3d4382e2a1f217ebf61c328db7.zh: 如果答案是他们一直就在那里，只是你没看见呢？

e7e6f64d1a90da6f4f4429ae7c849fbf4e27a929.en: Cheerful sunny yellow is an attention getter.
e7e6f64d1a90da6f4f4429ae7c849fbf4e27a929.zh: 明快的阳光黄能吸引注意力。

7376c7715704bb2b2c0c8b8a9aa52419006449fd.en: While it is considered an optimistic color, people lose their tempers more often in yellow rooms, and babies will cry more.
7376c7715704bb2b2c0c8b8a9aa52419006449fd.zh: 虽然黄色被视为乐观的颜色，但在黄色房间里人们更容易发脾气，婴儿也哭得更多。

81e4b72728d5685d38921304dd1588b39244215a.en: It is the most difficult color for the eye to take in, so it can be overpowering if overused.
81e4b72728d5685d38921304dd1588b39244215a.zh: 它是眼睛最难适应的颜色，因此如果使用过度会显得过于刺眼。

b55c7b991ac62217a45e0c4057e04a205c1aef32.en: Yellow enhances concentration, hence its use for legal pads.
b55c7b991ac62217a45e0c4057e04a205c1aef32.zh: 黄色能增强专注力，这也是便签纸常采用黄色的原因。

43409d154c9e60df343af5716ba297963c2445af.en: What history books tell us about the past is not everything that happened, but what historians have selected.
43409d154c9e60df343af5716ba297963c2445af.zh: 历史书告诉我们的过去并非发生的一切，而是历史学家所选取的部分。

a5b4a9496de32f3976044aeb4d2a29241ab0da72.en: They cannot put in everything: choices have to be made.
a5b4a9496de32f3976044aeb4d2a29241ab0da72.zh: 他们无法面面俱到：必须做出选择。

afd21d28c9e632aa476078e60749a8f74a17b43b.en: Choices must similarly be made about which aspects of the past should be formally taught to the next generation in the shape of school history lessons.
afd21d28c9e632aa476078e60749a8f74a17b43b.zh: 同样地，在将哪些过去的方面以历史课的形式正式传授给下一代时，也必须做出选择。

54beba6fdd0ef6cadbf2bb26196201372b8fc3ec.en: Schools host parent teacher conferences four times a year and it is important for families to attend.
54beba6fdd0ef6cadbf2bb26196201372b8fc3ec.zh: 学校每年举办四次家长会，家庭出席非常重要。

16cf550df8b24dd13c045c6ad7e7bb72f22cef02.en: This is your chance to meet with teachers and ask questions about your child's progress.
16cf550df8b24dd13c045c6ad7e7bb72f22cef02.zh: 这是你与老师见面并询问孩子学习进展的好机会。

1a37129de770dbf18b66255d0a6d710fb824a3fd.en: It can be helpful to write down questions ahead of time.
1a37129de770dbf18b66255d0a6d710fb824a3fd.zh: 提前写下问题会有所帮助。

46a6b63b3c9eed4535aaaf0e0589c1c0442c46d5.en: The whole purpose of making notes is to aid your learning.
46a6b63b3c9eed4535aaaf0e0589c1c0442c46d5.zh: 做笔记的全部目的是促进你的学习。

78d0f25dead3412b74ff4edd72ad20d207f395ec.en: It is important to go back over them within a day of making them to make sure they make sense and make them legible for future revisions.
78d0f25dead3412b74ff4edd72ad20d207f395ec.zh: 重要的是在记笔记后的一天内回顾它们，以确保内容通顺，并为未来的复习使其清晰可辨。

2dde9c5418007a870c5bc20f179ea5e02643b00f.en: Also, going back over them should highlight the key questions of areas in which you want to do further reading.
2dde9c5418007a870c5bc20f179ea5e02643b00f.zh: 此外，回顾笔记应能突出你希望进一步阅读的关键问题和领域。

6a0809e4ecc8bcde6c9336d7669b4c2b3bf0f0a4.en: A crew of scientists voyaged by ship from the southern tip of Chile into the frigid Antarctic to search for clues to one of the great unknowns of climate change.
6a0809e4ecc8bcde6c9336d7669b4c2b3bf0f0a4.zh: 一支科学家团队乘船从智利最南端出发，前往寒冷的南极洲，寻找气候变化这一重大未知之谜的线索。

dfd56bbae66efdc718f24e186de1552b4ba74860.en: They planned to crisscross a remote patch of sea near the spot where, a year earlier, another crew had injected a tankful of an inert chemical one mile below the surface.
dfd56bbae66efdc718f24e186de1552b4ba74860.zh: 他们计划在该海域一片偏远区域穿梭航行，该地点正是前一年另一支科考队在水面以下一英里处注入一整罐惰性化学物质的地方。

4d6da3329ff12f69b0d2498f699aeb0caadaf753.en: It seems that language appeared from nowhere since no other species has anything resembling human language.
4d6da3329ff12f69b0d2498f699aeb0caadaf753.zh: 语言似乎凭空出现，因为没有任何其他物种拥有与人类语言相似的东西。

d4faba01237f2bde22b7d48e42317939ee5eef88.en: However, other animals do possess basic systems for perceiving and producing sounds that enable them to communicate.
d4faba01237f2bde22b7d48e42317939ee5eef88.zh: 然而，其他动物确实拥有感知和发出声音的基本系统，使它们能够进行交流。

97fa9757983cc42800a68efc073c5750b1ef90cc.en: These systems may have been in place before the appearance of language.
97fa9757983cc42800a68efc073c5750b1ef90cc.zh: 这些系统可能在语言出现之前就已经存在。

c57cbd6731d5221493a3a7d9e486cbcd3c1d740f.en: Around the world, city residents build gardens on balconies, rooftops and small strips of land.
c57cbd6731d5221493a3a7d9e486cbcd3c1d740f.zh: 在全球各地，城市居民在阳台、屋顶和狭小的土地上建造花园。

cfa87053a4aac3844dfa5eb6bd3d7a727d5d6b23.en: A March 2023 study published in the journal Ecology Letters confirms that beyond offering food and an outlet for cultivating outdoor space, urban gardens provide benefits for the humans, insects, and animals who inhabit these leafy respites from city life.
cfa87053a4aac3844dfa5eb6bd3d7a727d5d6b23.zh: 2023年3月发表在《生态快报》上的一项研究证实，除了提供食物和开辟户外空间外，城市花园还为居住在这些城市生活绿洲中的人类、昆虫和动物带来益处。

32b6f246360f7f9cfd04ac3a9762deeffd63acdb.en: Located at the heart of two world famous cities, Liverpool and London, Liverpool's excellence in teaching, learning and research, first-class facilities and outstanding support places the university in the top 1% of universities worldwide.
32b6f246360f7f9cfd04ac3a9762deeffd63acdb.zh: 利物浦大学坐落于世界著名城市利物浦和伦敦的中心地带，其卓越的教学、学习和研究实力、一流的设施以及出色的支持体系，使其跻身全球前1%的大学行列。

5f52763f0e9c01426dc3cf71948e3598ab71db64.en: The University of Liverpool will provide you with an inspiring student experience, in a diverse international community.
5f52763f0e9c01426dc3cf71948e3598ab71db64.zh: 利物浦大学将在一个多元化的国际社区中为你提供令人振奋的求学体验。

0bd63b235375afd65a6d30dda55225bc4ac29c79.en: The core of the problem was the immense disparity between the country's productive capacity and the ability of people to consume.
0bd63b235375afd65a6d30dda55225bc4ac29c79.zh: 问题的核心在于该国的生产能力与民众的消费能力之间存在巨大差距。

89328e4dc3b0ddddb94f7256c29229b15c6a887d.en: Great innovations in productive techniques during and after the war raised the output of industry beyond the purchasing capacity of U.S. farmers and wage earners.
89328e4dc3b0ddddb94f7256c29229b15c6a887d.zh: 战时及战后生产技术的重大创新使工业产出超出了美国农民和工薪阶层的购买力。

5137b907d9ff96ea820530fb328dd20e9aea08aa.en: Your tutor helps you make the most of your time at university by giving you guidance and support along the way.
5137b907d9ff96ea820530fb328dd20e9aea08aa.zh: 你的导师会通过提供指导和支持，帮助你充分利用大学时光。

ffb1711fedf36046252f15564238911c8a29b4c8.en: All new students are allocated a personal tutor who will encourage you to get the most out of your course, direct you to other sources of support and help you achieve your goals.
ffb1711fedf36046252f15564238911c8a29b4c8.zh: 所有新生都会被分配一名个人导师，他将鼓励你从课程中获益最多，指引你获取其他支持资源，并帮助你实现目标。

2b3d806089958914306bc8329839daa014ca047c.en: Major breeding areas, and breeding islands, are shown as dark green areas or darts.
2b3d806089958914306bc8329839daa014ca047c.zh: 主要繁殖区和繁殖岛屿以深绿色区域或箭头标示。

f7c1c7d20b62f6d3f1c689bc96d1835d140808a4.en: Open darts are shown no-breeding records on islands, and are also used for offshore sightings, that is from ships or boats.
f7c1c7d20b62f6d3f1c689bc96d1835d140808a4.zh: 开放箭头用于表示岛上的无繁殖记录，也用于离岸观测记录，即来自船只或船舶的观察结果。

8354bf61e6dda8fc3e35bffe253312cc009b08ce.en: Other areas where species are not meant to be seen are plain pale green, with pale green hatching where records are usually sparse.
8354bf61e6dda8fc3e35bffe253312cc009b08ce.zh: 物种不应出现的其他区域为浅绿色，在记录通常稀疏的区域则使用浅绿色阴影填充。

c890a4885e1b23fc253723f0f36568e2a871be9a.en: There is no single method of learning that guarantees success.
c890a4885e1b23fc253723f0f36568e2a871be9a.zh: 没有一种学习方法能保证成功。

fda77758c03ff52f1aa5aa6c4504bdfcadaa293c.en: How we learn that depends on many different factors.
fda77758c03ff52f1aa5aa6c4504bdfcadaa293c.zh: 我们如何学习取决于许多不同的因素。

f1de08cf66a2d29677819d0c505149d1e58ff511.en: And what works best for you will not necessarily be the same as the approach used for the other students even they study the same course.
f1de08cf66a2d29677819d0c505149d1e58ff511.zh: 对你最有效的学习方法，不一定与其他学生即使修读同一门课程所采用的方法相同。

8896bc21976634c13d10a48b5aba62e578b121a7.en: We are all unique as learners, although some patterns emerge from any groups of students.
8896bc21976634c13d10a48b5aba62e578b121a7.zh: 作为学习者，我们都是独一无二的，尽管从任何学生群体中都能发现一些共同的模式。

8af596508f197059916a9166b731ce26a447cfdf.en: In classes, your teachers will talk about topics that you are studying.
8af596508f197059916a9166b731ce26a447cfdf.zh: 在课堂上，老师会讨论你正在学习的主题。

293b33c73ade416220597bc32b7e980c01e3be0e.en: The information that they provide will be important to know when you take tests.
293b33c73ade416220597bc32b7e980c01e3be0e.zh: 他们提供的信息对于你参加考试时非常重要。

0b863622f06d1d73c2b39f4e3cced863db2a66dd.en: You must be able to take good written notes from what your teachers say.
0b863622f06d1d73c2b39f4e3cced863db2a66dd.zh: 你必须能够根据老师的讲解做好书面笔记。

ebbc454523b4057fbee5c3eb25ca51b88eb849e8.en: For centuries, Atlantis has been one of the western world's favorite legends, a tantalizing blend of fantasy and mystery.
ebbc454523b4057fbee5c3eb25ca51b88eb849e8.zh: 几个世纪以来，亚特兰蒂斯一直是西方世界最喜爱的传说之一，是幻想与神秘交织的迷人故事。

b138f6bed67b8923608ad7ad5188a7d4d8e1b55f.en: Stories tell of a rich and glorious empire that was lost to the sea – where some hope its ruins still lie, waiting to be discovered.
b138f6bed67b8923608ad7ad5188a7d4d8e1b55f.zh: 传说曾有一个富庶而辉煌的帝国沉入海底，有人希望它的遗迹仍在那里，等待被发现。

1f1174b9820764f4ee284bac1426e35ce2843f64.en: Studying abroad is a very popular option for students who come from a wealthy family.
1f1174b9820764f4ee284bac1426e35ce2843f64.zh: 对于来自富裕家庭的学生来说，出国留学是一个非常受欢迎的选择。

734c136d501b3cbda0c975779cfe712db23eca84.en: Most people believe that the overseas experience provides a deeper understanding of cultures and develops communication skills.
734c136d501b3cbda0c975779cfe712db23eca84.zh: 大多数人认为，海外经历能让人更深入地了解文化，并培养沟通能力。

b325477804f42b4faf0e55128b6f55bc08278632.en: While this may be true, not all of the new experiences are useful for finding a job.
b325477804f42b4faf0e55128b6f55bc08278632.zh: 虽然这可能属实，但并非所有的新经历都对找工作有用。

a5c349af31ed855e43632ba5a267a93b31bdd976.en: Employers tend to value interpersonal skills and knowledge more than cultural background.
a5c349af31ed855e43632ba5a267a93b31bdd976.zh: 雇主往往更看重人际交往能力和知识，而非文化背景。

ae1bf75b512b127acc04e06cea0477386072ea1a.zh: 夏山学校由A.S.尼尔于1921年创立。

73cbc14384c15aa9a28d35a5f9ef627770c3ac12.en: Neill, the Summerhill School is known for its unique approach to education.
73cbc14384c15aa9a28d35a5f9ef627770c3ac12.zh: 夏山学校以其独特的教育理念而闻名。

32b5fec1a178e988b22dc705f1ecbf3b5d76ed84.en: At Summerhill, students have the freedom to choose their own activities and are encouraged to participate in the decision-making process.
32b5fec1a178e988b22dc705f1ecbf3b5d76ed84.zh: 在夏山学校，学生可以自由地选择自己的活动，并被鼓励参与决策过程。

2bea791a095d91721bf556e65f2c36bd2d413702.en: This student-centered approach promotes self-expression, creativity, and personal development.
2bea791a095d91721bf556e65f2c36bd2d413702.zh: 这种以学生为中心的教学方法促进了自我表达、创造力和个人发展。

6687a3df8e4f2895c75009fcdc82ef19b2f0001d.en: Tesla's theoretical work formed the basis of modern alternating current electric power systems.
6687a3df8e4f2895c75009fcdc82ef19b2f0001d.zh: 特斯拉的理论工作构成了现代交流电电力系统的基础。

3f79ff9598dfdae24b970c13b60847fc1c6c45e7.en: Thomas Edison promised him almost one million dollars in today's money to undertake motor and generator improvement.
3f79ff9598dfdae24b970c13b60847fc1c6c45e7.zh: 托马斯·爱迪生承诺给他几乎一百万美元（按今天的货币价值计算），以开展电动机和发电机的改进工作。

d50d5a07b58bb5682193bebde22c60db51240a22.en: However, when Tesla asked about the money, Edison reportedly replied 'Tesla, you don't understand our American humor.' The pair became arch-rivals.
d50d5a07b58bb5682193bebde22c60db51240a22.zh: 然而，当特斯拉问及这笔钱时，据报道爱迪生回答说：“特斯拉，你不懂我们的美式幽默。”两人从此成为死对头。

6696f5c6fa7a9c7ac5dec1cec6754a10cf92896f.en: Two sisters were at a dinner party when the conversation turned to upbringing.
6696f5c6fa7a9c7ac5dec1cec6754a10cf92896f.zh: 两姐妹在晚宴上，话题转到了家庭教育。

2dfe3ff550f6d25ce4e8bc845758334ff4608ff9.en: The elder sister started to say that her parents had been very strict and that she had been rather frightened of them.
2dfe3ff550f6d25ce4e8bc845758334ff4608ff9.zh: 姐姐开始说她的父母非常严厉，她对他们相当害怕。

36911f44578c199712c69e63d474ccffe81660a8.en: Her sister, younger by two years, interrupted in amazement.
36911f44578c199712c69e63d474ccffe81660a8.zh: 小她两岁的妹妹惊讶地打断了她。

01472dfe8e89acd6dcbfa5464b44198f8f419a7a.en: 'What are you talking about?' she said.

9ac0f7bb69b72573fd8dc8d56f32c2b4afc92c1b.en: Sleep behavior is also known as sleep disorder.
9ac0f7bb69b72573fd8dc8d56f32c2b4afc92c1b.zh: 睡眠行为异常也被称为睡眠障碍。

56a04ee99646e9a59463ec68b49ecb896d5546dc.en: People with sleep disorder often talk or walk in their sleep.
56a04ee99646e9a59463ec68b49ecb896d5546dc.zh: 患有睡眠障碍的人经常在睡中说梦话或梦游。

210ac62dee1a1a1c9f667b3d3e98bf287d43e519.en: They are not aware of what they are talking about or where they are going.
210ac62dee1a1a1c9f667b3d3e98bf287d43e519.zh: 他们不知道自己说了什么，也不知道自己去了哪里。

88c28690fe4439f93b5755f6712d9e83173c0246.en: There isn't any serious effect on the body in general but it may be connected to the mental health.
88c28690fe4439f93b5755f6712d9e83173c0246.zh: 这通常对身体健康没有严重影响，但可能与心理健康有关。

11b9f0e299cbfaf02c8770d94241f11eea65562d.en: People with childhood traumas, unspeakable problem or depression are the ones with different sleep behavior.
11b9f0e299cbfaf02c8770d94241f11eea65562d.zh: 有童年创伤、难以启齿的问题或抑郁症的人更容易出现睡眠行为异常。

a1a359e825c44bc26e1efdabe04fb6407776f6f6.en: The tortoise size and shell shape varies depending on where they live.
a1a359e825c44bc26e1efdabe04fb6407776f6f6.zh: 乌龟的大小和壳的形状因栖息地不同而异。

f21c29d319f90c83e19a79d1bd8cda3de51ff8e8.en: The shell is made of bone and is a dull brown color.
f21c29d319f90c83e19a79d1bd8cda3de51ff8e8.zh: 龟壳由骨骼构成，呈暗棕色。

3950052d103561526a843be86a55f87f1f78c71d.en: Their ribs, backbone and breastbone have become part of the shell, which is why you can never separate the tortoise from its shell.
3950052d103561526a843be86a55f87f1f78c71d.zh: 它们的肋骨、脊椎和胸骨已与外壳融为一体，因此你无法将乌龟与其壳分离。

c5efffd0f600aa896c76967a00cba97bf0305f81.en: The Classic Era of Mayan came to the end around 900 AD.
c5efffd0f600aa896c76967a00cba97bf0305f81.zh: 玛雅古典时代大约在公元900年结束。

f924b040229d427fec3f182ef76de22b6e79f046.zh: 发生这种情况的原因尚不清楚。

2c707ba41272744c1755124e45408dbba04c4e2f.en: The cities were probably over-farming the land, so that a period of drought led to famine.
2c707ba41272744c1755124e45408dbba04c4e2f.zh: 这些城市可能过度耕种土地，导致干旱时期引发了饥荒。

6be17aa866650adcfbdbbcd095fb38a5067a3a48.en: Recent geological research supports this, there appears to have been a 200-year drought around this time.
6be17aa866650adcfbdbbcd095fb38a5067a3a48.zh: 最近的地质研究支持这一观点，当时似乎出现了一场长达200年的干旱。

07cada0de1e9b67e0f973b4ac1c4e76221bd13cd.en: Many papers you write in college will require you to include quotes from one or more sources.
07cada0de1e9b67e0f973b4ac1c4e76221bd13cd.zh: 你在大学里写的许多论文都需要引用一个或多个来源的内容。

108ea531dad4030cb3500b6f6b8c369c1ae2a2b4.en: Even if you don't have to do it, integrating a few quotes into your writing can add life and persuasiveness to your arguments.
108ea531dad4030cb3500b6f6b8c369c1ae2a2b4.zh: 即使你不被要求这样做，在写作中融入一些引文也能让你的论点更加生动有力。

dec24eaf4207c7bda1e5045f8bc285f9bad6086b.en: The key is to use quotes to support a point you're trying to make rather than just include them to fill space.
dec24eaf4207c7bda1e5045f8bc285f9bad6086b.zh: 关键在于用引文来支持你试图阐述的观点，而不是仅仅为了凑篇幅而插入它们。

5e78c6ed619ec9876254c6457546a5315c45e4b8.en: The world's fifth largest continent: Antarctica is almost entirely covered by ice 2000 meters thick.
5e78c6ed619ec9876254c6457546a5315c45e4b8.zh: 世界第五大洲：南极洲几乎完全被2000米厚的冰层覆盖。

d1b2c4200592c42af113d4f9814502a5a2d23cb9.en: The area sustains varied wildlife including seals, whales, and penguins.
d1b2c4200592c42af113d4f9814502a5a2d23cb9.zh: 该地区栖息着包括海豹、鲸鱼和企鹅在内的多种野生动物。

841de276b85192c8221e6db998ce84f5ceda585f.en: The Antarctic treaty signed in 1959 and enforced since 1961 provides for international governance of Antarctica.
841de276b85192c8221e6db998ce84f5ceda585f.zh: 1959年签署并于1961年生效的《南极条约》规定了对南极洲的国际治理。
