ff29df47803f4cc0cb413fef1152dac49c5a0a19.zh: 农业面临的复杂问题之一是粮食浪费。

230a9ed7ab478bd4005e9e8f8fac359da13cda75.en: Food waste refers to the discarding of edible food at various stages of the food supply chain, from production to consumption.
230a9ed7ab478bd4005e9e8f8fac359da13cda75.zh: 粮食浪费是指在从生产到消费的整个食品供应链的各个阶段中丢弃可食用食物的行为。

4e5c80e2ec75c8b683cb0e9e0b3a77d41a73b733.en: This not only represents a significant loss of resources but also has environmental implications, such as greenhouse gas emissions from decomposing food waste in landfills.
4e5c80e2ec75c8b683cb0e9e0b3a77d41a73b733.zh: 这不仅意味着资源的巨大损失，还带来环境影响，例如填埋场中腐烂的厨余垃圾产生的温室气体排放。

311a76dd79ae0aaa530e9788e390691d7a28cf87.en: English colonies emerged along the eastern seaboard for a variety of reasons.
311a76dd79ae0aaa530e9788e390691d7a28cf87.zh: 出于多种原因，英国殖民地在东海岸陆续建立。

1146d5f1c952dab5233e93a8d51278e2b1011a4b.en: People, primarily men, originally migrated to Virginia to find gold and silver to make a quick profit.
1146d5f1c952dab5233e93a8d51278e2b1011a4b.zh: 最初，主要是男性移民前往弗吉尼亚寻找金银，以获取快速利润。

640605d6a127eb7a4ef568e86834111a065ed0a8.en: After it became evident that there were no precious metals in the area, men came to Virginia to start cultivating cash crops like tobacco.
640605d6a127eb7a4ef568e86834111a065ed0a8.zh: 当该地区没有贵金属的迹象变得明显后，人们来到弗吉尼亚州开始种植烟草等经济作物。

3785501d4d622e95969f12b0e14c7141bbcb7d5b.en: There are perhaps three ways of looking at furniture: some people see it as purely functional and useful, and don't bother themselves with aesthetics; others see it as essential to civilised living and concern themselves with design and how the furniture will look in a room.
3785501d4d622e95969f12b0e14c7141bbcb7d5b.zh: 看待家具或许有三方式：有些人认为它纯粹是功能性和有用的，不关心美学；另一些人则认为它是文明生活所必需的，关注设计和家具在房间里的外观。

1af3068422459f71675f88af2e0fcb32f4cc6938.en: In other words, function combined with aesthetics; and yet others see furniture as a form of art.
1af3068422459f71675f88af2e0fcb32f4cc6938.zh: 换句话说，就是功能与美学的结合；还有些人则将家具视为一种艺术形式。

ec613c73635f1358232751d4ec71e451501c2901.en: A study found that the research funded by the soft drinks industry has different results from research funded by other sources and went on to suggest that there may have been biassed by the research itself.
ec613c73635f1358232751d4ec71e451501c2901.zh: 一项研究发现，由软饮料行业资助的研究结果与其他来源资助的研究不同，并进一步指出这些研究可能存在偏见。

b2c3aecbd7e663d179ceb08ce97967d1d98fd00d.en: Three professors from Hamburg University's medical faculty travelled last month to Ingeborg's sitting room in East Berlin to test her on the work she carried out in prewar Germany.
b2c3aecbd7e663d179ceb08ce97967d1d98fd00d.zh: 上个月，汉堡大学医学院的三位教授前往东柏林英格博格的客厅，对她战前在德国进行的工作进行测试。

c2fd8e85dc5da05ad45718ebd1fa436e5b35a31f.en: Credit Cards are a ubiquitous form of payment that have revolutionised the way we conduct transactions.
c2fd8e85dc5da05ad45718ebd1fa436e5b35a31f.zh: 信用卡是一种无处不在的支付方式，彻底改变了我们进行交易的方式。

68825d7055b1fa130c4e4451b0d621b9ea7794d9.en: With a credit card, individuals can make purchases without having to carry cash or worry about the availability of funds.
68825d7055b1fa130c4e4451b0d621b9ea7794d9.zh: 使用信用卡，个人可以在无需携带现金或担心资金可用性的情况下进行购买。

e8986dc28ff38a910dee50d50a0b4709df4736d1.en: Credit cards also offer a range of benefits such as cashback rewards, travel points, and purchase protection.
e8986dc28ff38a910dee50d50a0b4709df4736d1.zh: 信用卡还提供一系列好处，如返现奖励、旅行积分和购物保障。

d23269adc2aaa0a29aebfb4c24ae8c5c208943a7.en: In 2005, donor countries agreed on an accord to harmonise their practises.
d23269adc2aaa0a29aebfb4c24ae8c5c208943a7.zh: 2005年，捐助国达成了一项协调其做法的协议。

8f5eca8c6703fbe552cf0b718e198a7202e07855.en: Since then, aid officials have complained that too little has changed on the ground.
8f5eca8c6703fbe552cf0b718e198a7202e07855.zh: 此后，援助官员抱怨说，实地情况变化甚微。

1db26d540f7a7ce94247f614fcd7941568dba315.en: Conferences of donors in developing countries still tend to be dominated by a small group of north European governments, with the US often absent.
1db26d540f7a7ce94247f614fcd7941568dba315.zh: 在发展中国家举行的捐助方会议仍往往由少数几个北欧政府主导，美国通常缺席。

2db2ff3210274e8bd85f825e8e48df523a2aea40.en: We understand that not everyone can put their job and other responsibilities on hold to study.
2db2ff3210274e8bd85f825e8e48df523a2aea40.zh: 我们理解，并非每个人都能暂停工作和其他责任去学习。

597e9f6f4e66c4419568d795b7b0b86c13c0c23e.en: That's why our healthcare ethics and law master's courses are available to study by distance learning, so you can fit gaining an academic qualification around your work and family.
597e9f6f4e66c4419568d795b7b0b86c13c0c23e.zh: 这就是为什么我们的医疗伦理与法律硕士课程提供远程学习模式，以便您在工作之余兼顾家庭，完成学业并获得学术资格。

3bacad810924b25354a16e7a0aa8d8bee785802a.en: Charlie Chaplin and his brother Sydney were placed in an orphanage at a very early age.
3bacad810924b25354a16e7a0aa8d8bee785802a.zh: 查理·卓别林和他的哥哥西德尼在很小的时候就被送进了孤儿院。

d0ca9fc00536eac71d3dd69233e762b0242a7481.en: Becoming a vaudeville performer, he joined Fred Karno's company in 1906.
d0ca9fc00536eac71d3dd69233e762b0242a7481.zh: 他成为杂耍演员后，于1906年加入了弗雷德·卡诺的公司。

c46667c42ce51f919f3c50d92ab51ae64dc32888.en: He made his film debut in Making a Living, 1914 and introduced the famous seedy and soft-hearted gentleman-tramp routine, which became his hallmark.
c46667c42ce51f919f3c50d92ab51ae64dc32888.zh: 他于1914年在电影《谋生》中首次亮相，并塑造了那个著名的落魄、心地善良的绅士流浪汉形象，这成为了他的标志性特征。

24c01f021149d153ad3aa84dbe30c967bec7b527.en: Numerous films for various studios brought him world fame, all based on his mastery of pathos and slapstick acrobatics.
24c01f021149d153ad3aa84dbe30c967bec7b527.zh: 他为多家制片厂拍摄了众多影片，凭借对悲情与滑稽杂技的精湛掌控赢得了世界声誉。

92101cf747b885de1263e06d4476a87fa5762fcf.en: A national study into fraud by bookkeepers employed at small and medium-sized businesses has uncovered 65 instances of theft in more than five years, with more than 31 million stolen.
92101cf747b885de1263e06d4476a87fa5762fcf.zh: 一项针对中小型企业雇佣的簿记员欺诈行为的全国性调查显示，在五年多的时间里发现了65起盗窃案，涉案金额超过3100万元。

4f090a8d31969baff5183b5ac1562f9b07513b7f.en: Of the cases identified by the research, 56 involved women and nine instances involved men.
4f090a8d31969baff5183b5ac1562f9b07513b7f.zh: 在研究确定的案件中，有56起涉及女性，9起涉及男性。

c5976140c7836f1579843e740dd4661b384045de.en: However, male bookkeepers who defrauded their employer stole three times, on average, the amount that women stole.
c5976140c7836f1579843e740dd4661b384045de.zh: 然而，实施欺诈的男簿记员平均盗窃金额是女性的三倍。

9969be9dbf4fcc91dfe6f6b195c559829454d659.en: In the fast-changing world of modern healthcare, the job of a doctor is more and more like the job of a chief executive.
9969be9dbf4fcc91dfe6f6b195c559829454d659.zh: 在现代医疗快速变化的世界中，医生的工作越来越像首席执行官的工作。

aa755116df4232ea20c0d3695c66f701ee9b4f35.en: The people who run hospitals and physicians' practises don't just need to know medicine.
aa755116df4232ea20c0d3695c66f701ee9b4f35.zh: 经营医院和医生诊所的人不仅需要懂医学。

c0a4a7ade51dc15a0ffb491a74dea9ad6a6e97a1.en: They must also be able to balance budgets, motivate a large and diverse staff and make difficult marketing and legal decisions.
c0a4a7ade51dc15a0ffb491a74dea9ad6a6e97a1.zh: 他们还必须能够平衡预算、激励庞大且多样化的员工队伍，并做出艰难的市场营销和法律决策。

c39823b692c6529bb34bffa92631758b3ffa7706.en: Yellow is the most optimistic colour, yet surprisingly, people lose their tempers most often in yellow rooms and babies cry more often in them.
c39823b692c6529bb34bffa92631758b3ffa7706.zh: 黄色是最具乐观色彩的颜色，但令人惊讶的是，人们在黄色房间里最容易发脾气，婴儿在黄色房间里也更容易哭泣。

2243fd131ac47c08ef594a461f2e1b53383e9142.en: The reason may be that yellow is the hardest colour on the eye.
2243fd131ac47c08ef594a461f2e1b53383e9142.zh: 原因可能是黄色是最伤眼的颜色。

a0d2c02ae1a80b028e31c865b4a077fb03d73446.en: On the other hand, it speeds up metabolism and enhances concentration; think of yellow legal pads and post-it notes.
a0d2c02ae1a80b028e31c865b4a077fb03d73446.zh: 另一方面，它能加速新陈代谢并增强专注力；想想黄色的法律用便笺和便利贴就知道了。

c9d6574b183c8ed0672732d9c93fc76c50848b9a.en: Perhaps the most measurable benefit of the programme has been the opportunity to me in small groups, something that is difficult to arrange such a desperate organisation.
c9d6574b183c8ed0672732d9c93fc76c50848b9a.zh: 该计划最可衡量的益处或许是让我得以在小团体中交流的机会，而在这样一个资源匮乏的组织里，这很难安排。

23c1a85501ed5d2402603823a98356fc46a4abcb.en: Many officers would have to work together for thirty years but would not know other's strengths and weaknesses.
23c1a85501ed5d2402603823a98356fc46a4abcb.zh: 许多警官共事三十年，却仍不了解彼此的优缺点。

2785bfc4eae756759dde6dc4f184736d064cc9e7.en: The uniquely scented flavour of vanilla is second only to chocolate in popularity on the world's palate.
2785bfc4eae756759dde6dc4f184736d064cc9e7.zh: 香草独特的香气和风味在世界各地的美味排行榜上仅次于巧克力。

3c6350897e5f48835f80c95f7ec25715543a8e6e.en: It's also the second most expensive spice after saffron.
3c6350897e5f48835f80c95f7ec25715543a8e6e.zh: 它也是仅次于藏红花的第二大昂贵香料。

8559439988db9384e9c8231b46400459b17966bc.en: But highly labor-intensive cultivation methods and the plant's temperamental life cycle and propagation mean production on a global scale is struggling to keep up with the increasing demand for the product.
8559439988db9384e9c8231b46400459b17966bc.zh: 但高度劳动密集型的种植方法以及植物多变的生长周期和繁殖特性意味着全球产量难以跟上对该产品日益增长的需求。

27283ff85b6e6f6f748a32c6618b1ed237b44ff0.en: The training of an actor is an intensive process which requires curiosity, courage and commitment.
27283ff85b6e6f6f748a32c6618b1ed237b44ff0.zh: 演员的训练是一个高强度的过程，需要好奇心、勇气和投入。

b9fbefec117a64d84672699420826cdf5c2c5dfc.en: You will learn how to prepare for rehearsal, how to rehearse and how to use independent and proactive processes that inform you to do the best work possible for both stage and screen.
b9fbefec117a64d84672699420826cdf5c2c5dfc.zh: 你将学习如何为排练做准备、如何进行排练，以及如何运用独立且主动的流程，以便在舞台和银幕上发挥出最佳表现。

cfd119d835f2e4fb7ea9a83b043a622af6163878.en: A university is a lot more than just classes and exams.
cfd119d835f2e4fb7ea9a83b043a622af6163878.zh: 大学远不止是上课和考试。

7faac21340245b053ed82a6649130c8eb092d3ae.en: University is a concept that offers you a host of possibilities to develop both academically and personally.
7faac21340245b053ed82a6649130c8eb092d3ae.zh: 大学是一个提供众多机会的概念，让你能在学术和个人成长方面得到全面发展。

a646a77f90c6901af037cca9d6ed388135cda1d5.en: Find out about the different projects, clubs and societies that are in your university.
a646a77f90c6901af037cca9d6ed388135cda1d5.zh: 了解你所在大学的不同项目、俱乐部和社团。

e726739cd571b7a49c66063234bd0880d57756ef.en: You will definitely find something you are interested in.
e726739cd571b7a49c66063234bd0880d57756ef.zh: 你一定会找到感兴趣的事物。

a6edc0e3e9c8ee0a329d9043388d2006d31c723b.en: Life expectancy has increased dramatically in the last century.
a6edc0e3e9c8ee0a329d9043388d2006d31c723b.zh: 在过去的一个世纪里，预期寿命大幅延长。

b95d84da4420d068cc3e26a835275a0eedc81c10.en: Most people these days will live for over 70 years.
b95d84da4420d068cc3e26a835275a0eedc81c10.zh: 如今大多数人能活过70岁。

6653054ab2e232cb8e6580ded4910cacd4392f87.en: This is more than double the lifespan of the average human in the seventeenth century.
6653054ab2e232cb8e6580ded4910cacd4392f87.zh: 这比17世纪人类的平均寿命翻了一番还多。

1ce403549533f2a9c10ff2057b05f4074bdb6b2c.en: We can attribute our longevity to advances in medicine and lifestyle.
1ce403549533f2a9c10ff2057b05f4074bdb6b2c.zh: 我们可以将长寿归功于医学和生活方式的进步。

818c8f52ccc6c2e7a8ebd15f233d2eaafc0b7b0e.en: While everyone agrees that living longer is wonderful, overpopulation is becoming a serious environmental concern.
818c8f52ccc6c2e7a8ebd15f233d2eaafc0b7b0e.zh: 虽然大家都认为活得更长是好事，但人口过剩正成为一个严重的环境问题。

2555070fce7c17a8ab8c81f6d520124ec4c566b0.en: Networking is easy and fun because it taps into this human predilection to talk about ourselves when asked.
2555070fce7c17a8ab8c81f6d520124ec4c566b0.zh: 社交 networking 既简单又有趣，因为它利用了人们在被问及时喜欢谈论自己的这一天性。

24eb3d55055ff8aafc6ad2fb89c9faf9ef6ca6a9.en: Consider successful networking as little more than the process of guiding a person to tell you about his life, what he's doing, the company that employs him, and his current industry.
24eb3d55055ff8aafc6ad2fb89c9faf9ef6ca6a9.zh: 可以把成功的社交看作仅仅是引导对方告诉你关于他的生活、他在做什么、他受雇于哪家公司以及他所在的行业的过程。

cfa4ea7016fe067a82f630064fccc612f4dc37ce.en: Living room is the most used part that withholds most of the traffic coming in and out of the house.
cfa4ea7016fe067a82f630064fccc612f4dc37ce.zh: 客厅是家中使用频率最高的区域，也是进出房屋人流最集中的地方。

6fa738efb1b9d3c893b2e9cbbefc2e76983c3bba.en: It is highly recommended that the flooring should be strong enough that it can endure all such amendments done with your furniture or to the increasing and decreasing ratio of visitors.
6fa738efb1b9d3c893b2e9cbbefc2e76983c3bba.zh: 强烈建议地板应足够坚固，能够承受家具移动带来的磨损以及访客数量增减的影响。

4428fb709db33e5fde323f7ef4e0ba65334b4717.en: For this purpose, you can opt for hardwood flooring.
4428fb709db33e5fde323f7ef4e0ba65334b4717.zh: 为此，您可以选择硬木地板。

6a56543bc9dff637c827cce5aad545c2b4fdd186.en: Being classy and sophisticated in look, it is the perfect choice for your living room whenever you are remodelling your home.
6a56543bc9dff637c827cce5aad545c2b4fdd186.zh: 它外观典雅精致，是您装修家居时客厅的完美选择。

c565106f1b2215b26bfbc59edcfa4479e5622fbd.en: This book is no ordinary book, and should not be read through from beginning to end.
c565106f1b2215b26bfbc59edcfa4479e5622fbd.zh: 这本书非同寻常，不应从头到尾通读。

fb5220d17f73f6c1e07295ca3cde784248dda4c9.en: It contains many different adventures, and the path you take will depend on the choices you make along the way.
fb5220d17f73f6c1e07295ca3cde784248dda4c9.zh: 书中包含许多不同的冒险故事，你走的路线将取决于你在途中所做的选择。

23d7a2d066b78b381dec488ea2c98c13dca1a25f.en: The success or failure of your mission will hinge on the decisions you make, so think carefully before choosing.
23d7a2d066b78b381dec488ea2c98c13dca1a25f.zh: 你的任务成功与否取决于你所做的决定，因此在做出选择前请仔细思考。

f168027a097a12da4e7960c6e82c6461350f7b0d.en: When we recycle, used materials are converted into new products, reducing the need to consume natural resources.
f168027a097a12da4e7960c6e82c6461350f7b0d.zh: 回收利用时，废旧材料被转化为新产品，从而减少了对自然资源的消耗需求。

75739c244a2acdbde89f522ca53807ffdc7a9eee.en: If used materials are not recycled, new products are made by extracting fresh, raw material from the Earth, through mining and forestry.
75739c244a2acdbde89f522ca53807ffdc7a9eee.zh: 如果废旧材料不被回收，新产品将通过采矿和林业从地球中开采新鲜原材料来制造。

a72bf575ef1783e10760a21a0815ce923843e3c1.en: Recycling helps conserve important raw materials and protects natural habitats for the future.
a72bf575ef1783e10760a21a0815ce923843e3c1.zh: 回收利用有助于保护重要的原材料，并为未来保护自然栖息地。

34a9aa378c3eba97faa74b4bf3491365b944c7a1.en: Political scholars had historically recognised the social love of the mass media.
34a9aa378c3eba97faa74b4bf3491365b944c7a1.zh: 政治学者历来认识到大众媒体所蕴含的社会情感。

6dbb0e7298f49cd68d8c041c768d3536b1ebb55d.en: The impact of the mass media on the electric and governing process has greatly increased over the last fifty years.
6dbb0e7298f49cd68d8c041c768d3536b1ebb55d.zh: 在过去五十年里，大众媒体对选举和治理过程的影响大大增加了。

2720b9108ab7fe78bb4c691b205b863dee0dfb3a.en: Tomorrow, the mass media will become the " central nervous system " for your society and the major source of public information.
2720b9108ab7fe78bb4c691b205b863dee0dfb3a.zh: 明天，大众媒体将成为你社会的“中枢神经系统”和公共信息的主要来源。

32fdde60509bf62a631c2a8add990f3711d0ca68.en: Having the same dream again and again is a well-known phenomenon, nearly two-thirds of the population report having recurring dreams.
32fdde60509bf62a631c2a8add990f3711d0ca68.zh: 反复做同一个梦是一个众所周知的现象，近三分之二的人口报告做过重复的梦。

2157f24d20dc91fba168054ba034bd4db1874984.en: Being chased, finding yourself naked in a public place or in the middle of a natural disaster, losing your teeth or forgetting to go to class for an entire semester are typical recurring scenarios in these dreams.
2157f24d20dc91fba168054ba034bd4db1874984.zh: 被追逐、在公共场所或自然灾害中发现自己裸体、掉牙或忘记去上课整整一个学期，都是这些梦中典型的重复场景。

d462084fa20587e0c000161aa4b03adf9982636d.en: The findings of modern research support the view that the evolution of primitive men and its culture should be regarded as " unity ".
d462084fa20587e0c000161aa4b03adf9982636d.zh: 现代研究的结果支持这样一种观点，即原始人类的进化及其文化应被视为“统一体”。

395c237a720346cdcd876521209120188c6a3973.en: Yet this unity is exceedingly complex, and future research will doubtless enable us to make finer distinctions between the periods that people composed it.
395c237a720346cdcd876521209120188c6a3973.zh: 然而，这种统一性极其复杂，未来的研究无疑将使我们能够更细致地区分构成它的各个时期。

33e637ab08954d3a2f25b96ac340063c38cceb75.en: IT may well change the way you live, yet again.
33e637ab08954d3a2f25b96ac340063c38cceb75.zh: 它可能会再次改变你的生活方式。

b6aa541e5295afba8228a693d010cc5545161199.en: Welcome to the world of mobile commerce, where your hand - held device, it's a mobile phone, a personal digital assistant or any other wireless application will soon be used for commercial transactions.
b6aa541e5295afba8228a693d010cc5545161199.zh: 欢迎来到移动商务的世界，在这里，你的手机、个人数字助理或其他任何无线应用设备很快将被用于商业交易。

b7a23187e7a717c256eb0d03edcd3dd57b962481.en: Consider these facts in Japan, mobile phones are used for location - based services where the mobile service provider ties - up with a host of other players such as restaurants or car rental companies.
b7a23187e7a717c256eb0d03edcd3dd57b962481.zh: 以日本为例，手机被用于基于位置的服务，移动服务提供商与餐厅或汽车租赁公司等众多合作伙伴联手。

bd72cdfd1268f8677c96a2cd8533a9b0f74ea6ff.en: A young man from a small provincial town, a man without independent wealth, without powerful family connections and without a university education, moves to London in the late 1580's, and in a remarkably short time, became the greatest playwright.
bd72cdfd1268f8677c96a2cd8533a9b0f74ea6ff.zh: 一位来自偏远小镇的年轻男子，没有独立财富，没有显赫的家族关系，也没有受过大学教育，于16世纪80年代末移居伦敦，并在极短的时间内成为了最伟大的剧作家。

659f2eea1d811a46dc04eb132177c58d6d2ea362.en: Not of his age alone but of all time.
659f2eea1d811a46dc04eb132177c58d6d2ea362.zh: 不仅属于他那个时代，更属于所有时代。

06f81788414d800ccde8d82d3abf79fe29e283c7.en: How is an achievement of this magnitude to be explained?
06f81788414d800ccde8d82d3abf79fe29e283c7.zh: 如此巨大的成就该如何解释？

cbab8acf3a9709217961cd46b9d78e775f90e7c3.zh: 莎士比亚是如何成为莎士比亚的？

325199bc8883353829b0e32d6ce9512c46b1407c.en: The Japanese tea ceremony is a tour influenced by Buddhism in which green tea is prepared and served to a small group of guests in a peaceful setting.
325199bc8883353829b0e32d6ce9512c46b1407c.zh: 日本茶道是一场受佛教影响的仪式，在宁静的环境中为少量客人准备并奉上绿茶。

88723295673dfb9832e1bee0d2912aae66541848.en: The ceremony can take as long as four hours and there are many traditional gestures that both the server and the guest must perform.
88723295673dfb9832e1bee0d2912aae66541848.zh: 这场仪式可能长达四个小时，主人和客人都需完成许多传统礼仪动作。

c4d480b71e59f03aff50d76525c5dd7b86cd1286.en: The numbers on U.S. student debt, after all, are truly staggering.
c4d480b71e59f03aff50d76525c5dd7b86cd1286.zh: 毕竟，美国学生债务的数字确实令人震惊。

53fa594583e61b34cb1b6f5af53f210c07b83427.en: The average 2015 U.S. university graduate who took out loans to help pay for tuition enters the workforce with 35,000 in student debt.
53fa594583e61b34cb1b6f5af53f210c07b83427.zh: 2015年背负助学贷款的美国大学毕业生平均在步入职场时背负着3.5万美元的学生债务。

e4571b8235b51ba1c19329726e863e57d4b96c12.en: In the U.S., total student debt exceeds 1.15 trillion dollars - dwarfing, for instance, the nation's credit card debt.
e4571b8235b51ba1c19329726e863e57d4b96c12.zh: 在美国，学生总债务已超过1.15万亿美元——远远超过该国的信用卡债务总额。

153af9f55a6ecb308565b727e2064139fec08dcf.en: From a child's point of view, what is the purpose of TV advertising?
153af9f55a6ecb308565b727e2064139fec08dcf.zh: 从孩子的角度来看，电视广告的目的是什么？

4932c375605b7c7ca8018a5241b4e416d6446cdc.en: Is advertising on TV done to give actors the opportunity to take a rest or practise their lines?
4932c375605b7c7ca8018a5241b4e416d6446cdc.zh: 电视上做广告是为了给演员休息或练习台词的机会吗？

2458209c2493747d0576faf9a4437671bcbf8640.en: Or is it done to make people buy things?
2458209c2493747d0576faf9a4437671bcbf8640.zh: 还是为了促使人们购买商品？

880a567e586e865e7fab940ab4c9f6244f3dd2dc.en: Furthermore, is the main difference between programmes and commercials that commercials are for real, whereas programmes are not, or that programmes are for kids and commercials for adults?
880a567e586e865e7fab940ab4c9f6244f3dd2dc.zh: 此外，节目和广告的主要区别在于广告是真实的而节目不是，还是节目面向儿童而广告面向成人？

4d1bc77ea18aa167aef55b194cf32486afdcb4a3.en: You must be able to take good written notes from what your teacher says.
4d1bc77ea18aa167aef55b194cf32486afdcb4a3.zh: 你必须能够认真记下老师所说的内容。

32de2a81ce4bf69d3e403ffbcd200ab2f852be5e.en: Three hundred and eighty years after his death, William Shakespeare remains the central author of the English - speaking world; he is the most quoted poet and the most regularly produced playwright - and now among the most popular screenwriters as well.
32de2a81ce4bf69d3e403ffbcd200ab2f852be5e.zh: 逝世三百八十年后，威廉·莎士比亚仍然是英语世界中最核心的作家；他是最常被引用的诗人，也是上演频率最高的剧作家——如今还成为最受欢迎的编剧之一。

308c0848696c0f3385280f56b17a4feaa1773343.en: Why is that, and who " is " he?
308c0848696c0f3385280f56b17a4feaa1773343.zh: 这是为什么？他到底是个什么人？

7a53d7aa038c7dd1a5523d069c45ea6333a7895a.en: Why do so many people think his writing is so great?
7a53d7aa038c7dd1a5523d069c45ea6333a7895a.zh: 为什么那么多人认为他的写作如此出色？

7877b35248317cdce690dba0f0f5a515c3a303c5.en: What meanings did his plays have in his own time, and how do we read, speak, or listen to his words now?
7877b35248317cdce690dba0f0f5a515c3a303c5.zh: 在他的时代，他的戏剧具有怎样的意义？如今我们该如何阅读、诵读或聆听他的文字？

16203356fcea7f8c7a7ebe4b315c8e6d4fe2a28b.en: Any writer must decide upon an order and a structure for a book in keeping with the reflexive nature of the work.
16203356fcea7f8c7a7ebe4b315c8e6d4fe2a28b.zh: 任何作家都必须根据作品的反思性特质，为书籍确定一种顺序和结构。

4ac18bb58283a4fe36686df3b8cd1f55cd965089.en: There are strong currents of reiteration in the book, with each iteration developing understandings of research, theory, and practise as the story continues to unfold.
4ac18bb58283a4fe36686df3b8cd1f55cd965089.zh: 书中充满了强烈的重复脉络，随着故事的展开，每一次迭代都深化了对研究、理论和实践的理解。

d2697fb1497560b983fe0b2c429beff0c4d1d143.en: Every morning, no matter how late he had been up, my father rose at five - thirty, went to his study, wrote for a couple of hours, made us all breakfast, read the paper with my mother, and then went back to work for the rest of the morning.
d2697fb1497560b983fe0b2c429beff0c4d1d143.zh: 每天早晨，无论他前一天晚上睡得多晚，父亲都会在五点半起床，走进书房，写作几个小时，为我们所有人做早餐，然后与母亲一起看报，接着继续工作直到上午结束。

aabd00da3dcb3f40efff89e3811b86acfe311b85.en: Many years passed before I realised that he did this by choice, for a living, and that he was not unemployed or mentally ill.
aabd00da3dcb3f40efff89e3811b86acfe311b85.zh: 多年以后我才意识到，他是出于自愿这样做来谋生，而不是失业或患有精神疾病。

a707fa6d334e8fc645258d14b82b8b6a77065ef9.en: The border itself between Mexico and United States is fraught with a mix of urban and desert terrain and spans over 1, 900 miles.
a707fa6d334e8fc645258d14b82b8b6a77065ef9.zh: 美墨边境本身地形复杂，融合了城市与沙漠地貌，绵延超过1900英里。

aaa0a9143b76ecaba5e824c3ef0b523e7be07a62.en: Both the uninhabited areas of the border and urban areas are where the most drug trafficking and illegal crossings take place.
aaa0a9143b76ecaba5e824c3ef0b523e7be07a62.zh: 边境无人区和城市地区是毒品走私和非法越境活动最猖獗的地方。

e15e3acd2a827cd94b5324d4b49214ca50e73451.en: Crime is prevalent in urban cities like El Paso, Texas and San Diego, California.
e15e3acd2a827cd94b5324d4b49214ca50e73451.zh: 德克萨斯州的埃尔帕索和加利福尼亚州的圣地亚哥等城市的犯罪现象十分普遍。

a346d274e5d2c3527ac73bc7c7f12b30eb0526d0.en: The Office of Personnel Management was the target of the attack, but data from nearly every government agency was stolen.
a346d274e5d2c3527ac73bc7c7f12b30eb0526d0.zh: 人事管理办公室是此次攻击的目标，但几乎每个政府机构的数据都被盗取。

0d7ca382ce4549d451c819d0a18c0af9c7a5c670.en: S. investigators say they believe Chinese hackers were behind the breach.
0d7ca382ce4549d451c819d0a18c0af9c7a5c670.zh: 调查人员表示，他们认为是中国黑客导致了这次数据泄露。

b3aa29bae1a8f29cb4357b9f36491fc1f0b817ac.en: Few things in the world produce such amazement as one's first of glimpse of the Grand Canyon; it took around more than 2 billion years to create this vast wonder, in some places.
b3aa29bae1a8f29cb4357b9f36491fc1f0b817ac.zh: 世界上很少有事物能像初次目睹大峡谷那样令人惊叹；在有些地方，创造这一宏伟奇观耗时超过20亿年。

ef64e18cc5e1be616da64bf125ef1422fd46b606.en: 17 miles wide, largely through the relentless force of Colorado River, which runs 277 miles along its length, a mile beneath its towering rims.
ef64e18cc5e1be616da64bf125ef1422fd46b606.zh: 大峡谷宽达17英里，主要是由科罗拉多河 relentless 的力量冲刷而成，这条河流沿着峡谷全长277英里流淌，位于高耸的崖壁下方约一英里处。

0c682693079abf24f3e29791b9d69ea5549cb426.en: Before the discovery of Australia, people in the old world were convinced that all swans were white, an unassailable belief as it seemed completely confirmed by empirical evidence.
0c682693079abf24f3e29791b9d69ea5549cb426.zh: 在发现澳大利亚之前，旧世界的人们坚信所有天鹅都是白色的，这一信念看似完全得到了经验证据的支持，因而坚不可摧。

0cfadd8eac3943e5123a0620e3584b010829e8c6.en: The sighting of the first black swan might have been an interesting surprise for a few scientists, but that is not where the significance of the story lies.
0cfadd8eac3943e5123a0620e3584b010829e8c6.zh: 第一只黑天鹅的出现或许让少数科学家感到惊喜，但这并非这个故事的意义所在。

158a8d5073d89c2f18d8ef21dd2a9e9ed2aa57cf.en: Research has shown that the gut microbiome is important for human physiology and health.
158a8d5073d89c2f18d8ef21dd2a9e9ed2aa57cf.zh: 研究表明，肠道微生物群对人体生理和健康至关重要。

62148f34c7d9977a9729c03421dd31139087de51.en: Disturbances to the composition of the gut microbiome can be associated with chronic diseases such as gastrointestinal inflammatory disorders, and neurological, cardiovascular and respiratory illnesses.
62148f34c7d9977a9729c03421dd31139087de51.zh: 肠道微生物群组成的紊乱可能与胃肠道炎症性疾病以及神经、心血管和呼吸系统疾病等慢性疾病有关。

3ea82de9bc2f3158e59f49cbf216f402c347ad88.en: The human body has evolved strategies to ensure that a symbiotic relationship exists between the microbes in our gut and our cells.
3ea82de9bc2f3158e59f49cbf216f402c347ad88.zh: 人体进化出了多种策略，以确保肠道微生物与人体细胞之间维持共生关系。

50a70b3e3f9a58519e5a6bd218b864ea23625eb7.en: In most developing countries, the human population is growing at a rate of 3 people per second.
50a70b3e3f9a58519e5a6bd218b864ea23625eb7.zh: 在大多数发展中国家，人口正以每秒3人的速度增长。

3ccda6f667e27aab9a68eeaf1cf633a5f2d7fcef.en: At the beginning of each fiscal year funds are allocated to each State account in accordance with the University's financial plan.
3ccda6f667e27aab9a68eeaf1cf633a5f2d7fcef.zh: 在每个财政年度开始时，资金将根据大学的财务计划分配至各州账户。

abfe13f329dab63fa9f9040a3df9490dec193b0d.en: Funds are allocated to each account by object of expenditure.
abfe13f329dab63fa9f9040a3df9490dec193b0d.zh: 资金按支出对象分配至各个账户。

e6556fc4273d486c2b957798617ecc5b2b283538.en: Account managers are responsible for ensuring that adequate funds are available in the appropriate object before initiating transactions to use the funds.
e6556fc4273d486c2b957798617ecc5b2b283538.zh: 账户管理员负责确保在发起使用资金的交易前，相应支出对象中有充足的可用资金。

3f1fdb9065494138c4bb6a5d3b3647f03c80d8a8.en: Plants play a crucial role in ecosystems, serving as a foundation and contributing to human well - being by providing resources such as food and medicine.
3f1fdb9065494138c4bb6a5d3b3647f03c80d8a8.zh: 植物在生态系统中发挥着至关重要的作用，作为基础并为人类福祉做出贡献，提供食物和药物等资源。

f07db19deaf142acd43c513bf93b879bec59f2a6.en: In order to gain a deeper understanding of how plants can adapt and remain resilient in the face of challenges like climate change, scientists have developed an innovative mathematical model.
f07db19deaf142acd43c513bf93b879bec59f2a6.zh: 为了更深入地了解植物如何适应气候变化等挑战并保持韧性，科学家开发了一种创新的数学模型。

8dbe6c7607ef603290b017ea9b13321565697549.en: Your subject outlines are a good place to go to find information about which textbooks to buy.
8dbe6c7607ef603290b017ea9b13321565697549.zh: 你的课程大纲是查找购买哪些教科书信息的好去处。

6bb41e65234c2f8914fffac4511cae5980b6b4eb.en: You will usually be given one of these for each subject in the first lecture, but if you are missing one or need one earlier then you should contact the subject coordinator.
6bb41e65234c2f8914fffac4511cae5980b6b4eb.zh: 在第一堂课上，你通常会为每门课程收到一份这样的资料，但如果你缺少或需要提前获取，请联系课程协调员。

e21edcc1f1c8d2621f8c05376a6db2e9e9f43177.en: Botanic gardens are scientific and cultural institutions established to collect, study, exchange and display plants for research and for the education and enjoyment of the public.
e21edcc1f1c8d2621f8c05376a6db2e9e9f43177.zh: 植物园是为了收集、研究、交换和展示植物以供研究和公众教育及娱乐而建立的科学与文化机构。

d135181a40b7e0b35341eff1a0c4c9d4c0bba146.en: There are major botanic gardens in each capital city.
d135181a40b7e0b35341eff1a0c4c9d4c0bba146.zh: 每个首府城市都有主要的植物园。

6fbd54f9ed28185856bb930638ee62d2a80487d5.en: Zoological parks and aquariums are primarily engaged in the breeding, preservation and display of native and exotic fauna in captivity.
6fbd54f9ed28185856bb930638ee62d2a80487d5.zh: 动物园和水族馆主要从事圈养本土和外来动物的繁殖、保护和展示工作。

b7a6d9659daedbfe4cc3e3d68da2684fff937f37.en: Marriage is a big step in anyone's life and there is an argument to be made against getting married too early.
b7a6d9659daedbfe4cc3e3d68da2684fff937f37.zh: 结婚是任何人生活中的重大一步，而且有人主张不应过早结婚。

7ecd79aeddbf7f5430b8252d3b54c4d4a9dfc97c.en: As any newlywed couple knows, there is a huge amount of financial pressure associated with marriage.
7ecd79aeddbf7f5430b8252d3b54c4d4a9dfc97c.zh: 任何新婚夫妇都知道，婚姻伴随着巨大的经济压力。

6f923b79063ef2f9c7d6af253fa69b5e362d73e1.en: Firstly, the wedding reception and honeymoon will cost you an arm and a leg.
6f923b79063ef2f9c7d6af253fa69b5e362d73e1.zh: 首先，婚礼招待会和蜜月旅行会花费你一大笔钱。

47dd8f80bc160e49ce18f919167fa2c01406fb51.en: Then there's the matter of home loans, rent and energy bills.
47dd8f80bc160e49ce18f919167fa2c01406fb51.zh: 还有房贷、租金和水电费的问题。

b0f5d7db3be71d512aee3888d54efd1ebfa44c58.en: If you're looking to start a family, your child's education is another thing you need to save up for.
b0f5d7db3be71d512aee3888d54efd1ebfa44c58.zh: 如果你打算组建家庭，孩子的教育费用是另一项你需要储蓄的目标。

3b8f1f7aeb28c6faded1ca29c90dc7d7fefa719b.en: Teenagers should probably find a proper job before deciding to tie the knot.
3b8f1f7aeb28c6faded1ca29c90dc7d7fefa719b.zh: 年轻人可能在决定结婚前应该先找一份正经工作。

310e33265c5bb1cf95aae55a49da9f79b71d9674.en: Thus, a country might possess a sizeable rural population, but have an economic system in which the interests of the voters were predominantly related to their incomes, not to their occupations or location; and in such a country the political system would be unlikely to include an important agrarian party.
310e33265c5bb1cf95aae55a49da9f79b71d9674.zh: 因此，一个国家可能拥有庞大的农村人口，但其经济体系中选民的利益主要与收入相关，而非职业或居住地；在这样的国家里，政治体系不太可能包含一个重要的农业政党。

5ea49ec829b3ec1927004f20146d8dc70b672d24.en: The physical location of a restaurant in the competitive landscape of the city has long been known as a major factor in its likely success or failure.
5ea49ec829b3ec1927004f20146d8dc70b672d24.zh: 在城市激烈的竞争格局中，餐厅的地理位置长期以来一直被认为是其成功或失败的主要因素。

fcb3691e7c65cf69385840a13ed5be5c68a4d05d.en: Once restaurants are established in such environments they can do little about their location.
fcb3691e7c65cf69385840a13ed5be5c68a4d05d.zh: 一旦餐厅在这样的环境中确立下来，它们对地理位置的选择就无能为力了。

1184511b74228ad442407e130b47ec4590f88c7d.en: All they can do is work to improve customer access to their premises.
1184511b74228ad442407e130b47ec4590f88c7d.zh: 他们能做的只是努力改善客户进入其场所的便利性。

99f79eb9049aaf0445c7016ff43ee084e1419af8.en: Restaurateurs often do this by engaging in battles with local authorities about car parking.
99f79eb9049aaf0445c7016ff43ee084e1419af8.zh: 餐馆老板经常通过与当地当局就停车问题展开斗争来实现这一目标。

b01525b80b37a2eb9cd36d272d619fef26ae3dac.en: The most obvious change is that 46 percent of college undergraduates are now women.
b01525b80b37a2eb9cd36d272d619fef26ae3dac.zh: 最明显的变化是，如今46%的大学生本科生是女性。

3924ab0fa2fb6f18c77da8cf9ca7bbde4231ee26.en: When I went there, it was only the third year that women had been admitted, and then seemingly grudgingly: about 70 percent of students were male, and if there was a woman tutor, she must have been a male impersonator.
3924ab0fa2fb6f18c77da8cf9ca7bbde4231ee26.zh: 我去那里时，那是女性被录取的第三年，而且似乎是被迫的：大约70%的学生是男性，如果有一位女导师，她一定是个男扮女装的人。

d3f587e53fff28988f5b6ca47c9db969a3e477cb.en: One of the major factors influencing future home design will be the probable change in climate, with hotter summers, colder winters, and the possibility of floods.
d3f587e53fff28988f5b6ca47c9db969a3e477cb.zh: 影响未来住宅设计的主要因素之一是气候可能发生的变化，包括更热的夏天、更冷的冬天以及洪水的可能性。

9319dbfeccf7ebbceea0273df0b6428555331f96.en: Consequently, houses will be built with better insulation and will also need ways of keeping cool in hot weather, whether that's air conditioning or more shading of windows.
9319dbfeccf7ebbceea0273df0b6428555331f96.zh: 因此，房屋将建造得具有更好的隔热性能，并且还需要在炎热天气中保持凉爽的方法，无论是空调还是更多的窗户遮阳。

06cc857d6b97cbb099de2ced1bbcba1b278ee6cb.en: When countries assess their annual carbon dioxide emissions, they count up their cars and power stations, but bush fires are not included presumably because they are deemed to be events beyond human control.
06cc857d6b97cbb099de2ced1bbcba1b278ee6cb.zh: 当各国评估其年度二氧化碳排放量时，他们会统计汽车和发电站的数量，但丛林大火未被计入，大概是因为它们被视为超出人类控制范围的事件。

e6760adedbaf9f43b9e9cc4236db737c0733cfe3.en: In Australia, Victoria alone sees several hundred thousand hectares burn each year in both 2004 and the present summer, the figure has been over 1 million hectares.
e6760adedbaf9f43b9e9cc4236db737c0733cfe3.zh: 在澳大利亚，仅维多利亚州每年就有数十万公顷的土地燃烧，2004年和今年夏季的数据均超过100万公顷。

7047ff8c650b22f55f299c4e30c396e931b3c6ff.en: Of course we use a lot of data to inform our decisions, but we also rely very heavily on iteration, research, testing, intuition and human empathy.
7047ff8c650b22f55f299c4e30c396e931b3c6ff.zh: 当然，我们使用大量数据来指导决策，但我们也非常依赖迭代、研究、测试、直觉和人类同理心。

ce176eb84c3e532abbabde234611f3f549da7870.en: Now, sometimes the designers who work on these products are called " data-driven, " which is a term that totally drives us bonkers.
ce176eb84c3e532abbabde234611f3f549da7870.zh: 现在，有时负责这些产品的设计师被称为“数据驱动”，这个术语让我们完全抓狂。

8827022da6736d3690aa30752bb55e068d9c0ad5.en: The fact is, it would be irresponsible of us not to rigorously test our designs when so many people are counting on us to get it right.
8827022da6736d3690aa30752bb55e068d9c0ad5.zh: 事实是，当如此多的人指望我们做出正确决策时，如果不严格测试我们的设计，那将是不负责任的。

24974a33fa017bf541d054cd1d59d4abfe87e04d.en: However, when Tesla, an ethical Serbs, asked about the money, Edison reported reply " Tesla, you don't understand our American humour.
24974a33fa017bf541d054cd1d59d4abfe87e04d.zh: 然而，当一位有道德感的塞尔维亚人特斯拉向爱迪生询问钱款事宜时，爱迪生回复道：“特斯拉，你不懂我们的美式幽默。”

ee313779603b0abf020339044d5040380a304856.zh: 澳大利亚人当然说英语。

caf048a384c0f4b88565f04a7f75be64abfc03ad.en: But for many tourists and even some locals, Australian English has only tenuous links with the mother tongue.
caf048a384c0f4b88565f04a7f75be64abfc03ad.zh: 但对于许多游客甚至一些当地人来说，澳大利亚英语与母语的联系非常薄弱。

f91045cc548565d8adbeae6ba08c49986157469f.en: Our speech is peppered with words and phrases whose arcane means understood only by the initiate.
f91045cc548565d8adbeae6ba08c49986157469f.zh: 我们的言语中充斥着那些只有内行人才懂的晦涩词汇和短语。

64e7390722590277fdfa88158bcfa11f4e1f2100.en: It is these colourful colloquialisms that Australian slang sets to truly explain.
64e7390722590277fdfa88158bcfa11f4e1f2100.zh: 正是这些色彩斑斓的口语表达，才真正体现了澳大利亚俚语的特色。

4b99fa12365c1c31401d9c8d1c89c20cca935a8a.en: Globalisation refers to a set of changes rather than a single change.
4b99fa12365c1c31401d9c8d1c89c20cca935a8a.zh: 全球化指的是一系列变化，而非单一的变化。

2039f0d901cf7c66255bea85bc7ee5cf29670397.en: Many of these changes are social, cultural and political rather than purely economic, and one of the main drivers in addition to the global marketplace is the communication revolution.
2039f0d901cf7c66255bea85bc7ee5cf29670397.zh: 其中许多变化是社会、文化和政治层面的，而非纯粹经济层面的；除了全球市场之外，另一个主要驱动力是通信革命。

8905a14a834e6472cf06b206d815693f0ac38aca.en: For centuries, Atlantis has been one of the western world's favourite legends, a tantalising blend of fantasy and mystery.
8905a14a834e6472cf06b206d815693f0ac38aca.zh: 几个世纪以来，亚特兰蒂斯一直是西方世界最喜爱的传说之一，它是幻想与神秘交织的诱人组合。

05654174892e3072b9aabd5068ca3f544000dcdb.en: Stories tell of a rich and glorious empire that was lost to the sea, where some hope its ruins still lie, waiting to be discovered.
05654174892e3072b9aabd5068ca3f544000dcdb.zh: 传说中描述了一个富饶而辉煌的帝国沉入海底，有人希望它的遗迹仍在那里，等待被发现。

00fd1b7ad22dc915cfa1d42b1ad2e03bc61ca15c.en: The noise restrictions are based on measurements on animals in captivity exposed to noise levels that induce a temporary threshold shift, TTS, in hearing.
00fd1b7ad22dc915cfa1d42b1ad2e03bc61ca15c.zh: 噪音限制是基于对圈养动物的测量结果制定的，这些动物暴露于能引起听力暂时性阈移（TTS）的噪音水平下。

194fd18d0435e177601423bb8d9fb8f0bc15d302.en: The TTS onset threshold is the lowest noise exposure capable of inducing a small temporary reduction of hearing sensitivity, also known as auditory fatigue, with full recovery shortly after exposure.
194fd18d0435e177601423bb8d9fb8f0bc15d302.zh: TTS起始阈值是指能够引起听力敏感性轻微暂时性降低（也称为听觉疲劳）的最低噪音暴露水平，且在暴露后不久即可完全恢复。

ad43d9a884ed8aab1a4545ca3db219d9a8260cd3.en: Great innovations in productive techniques during and after the war raised the output of industry beyond the purchasing capacity of U.S. farmers and earners.
ad43d9a884ed8aab1a4545ca3db219d9a8260cd3.zh: 战时及战后生产技术的重大创新使工业产出超出了美国农民和工薪阶层的购买力。

482da662dbfc971d9204b4578d46c2e379093765.en: Most people do not realise that some banks literally make money by giving loans without having money on deposit.
482da662dbfc971d9204b4578d46c2e379093765.zh: 大多数人没有意识到，有些银行确实是通过发放贷款来创造货币的，而无需在存款中持有相应资金。

488e57ae832ff3ba1f46dbe1794494a4bc16b645.en: The system is called fractional reserve banking and is used in most economies.
488e57ae832ff3ba1f46dbe1794494a4bc16b645.zh: 这种制度被称为部分准备金银行制度，并被大多数经济体所采用。

64e5321e893e2f4598d9e53f39dc7efea4bc6851.en: It sounds as though it is safe because it says that banks have to keep a fraction of their deposits with the Reserve Bank.
64e5321e893e2f4598d9e53f39dc7efea4bc6851.zh: 听起来很安全，因为它规定银行必须将一部分存款存放在中央银行。

61f3d752f37fa87e4501fcda87a2705e73f4d2d1.en: It's time for this young loggerhead turtle to go to work.
61f3d752f37fa87e4501fcda87a2705e73f4d2d1.zh: 这只幼年棱皮龟该去工作了。

61778acaa79b2a78e59c464cb18a29a137966105.en: We can tether turtles in these little cloth harnesses, put them into this tank and dull swimming place.
61778acaa79b2a78e59c464cb18a29a137966105.zh: 我们可以用这种小布制挽具把海龟拴住，然后把它们放入这个水箱和昏暗的游泳场所。

e3f03ecddd8ac524cea369ad90a270fc74d91919.en: University of North Carolina biologist Ken Loman studies sea turtles that are programmed from birth for an extraordinary journey.
e3f03ecddd8ac524cea369ad90a270fc74d91919.zh: 北卡罗来纳大学的生物学家肯·洛曼研究那些从出生起就注定要进行非凡迁徙的海龟。

c4b52cf3a50c9679b9a5bdb61874dbb26841f10a.en: Mother turtles buried the eggs on the beach and then returned to the sea and the eggs hatch about 50 to 60 days later.
c4b52cf3a50c9679b9a5bdb61874dbb26841f10a.zh: 母龟将卵埋在沙滩上，然后返回大海，约50至60天后卵便会孵化。

f431b8362a1162411a522c609e063668d6c302c0.en: Food is one of the most important things you'll ever buy.
f431b8362a1162411a522c609e063668d6c302c0.zh: 食物是你一生中购买的最重要的东西之一。

90516193575423d268eaca55b70e5fb46385023d.en: And yet most people never bother to think about their food and where it comes from.
90516193575423d268eaca55b70e5fb46385023d.zh: 然而，大多数人从不费心去思考他们的食物及其来源。

c96cd211f1c797836e5d51f46e1fa1d5920fedf9.en: People spend a lot more time worrying about what kind of blue jeans to wear, what kind of video games to play, what kind of computers to buy.
c96cd211f1c797836e5d51f46e1fa1d5920fedf9.zh: 人们花更多时间担心穿什么样的牛仔裤、玩什么样的电子游戏、买什么样的电脑。

a12d0941063863b8cc61e210bea25913edb02798.en: Choices must similarly be made about which aspects of the past should be formally taught to the next generation in the shape of school history class.
a12d0941063863b8cc61e210bea25913edb02798.zh: 同样地，也必须做出选择，决定哪些过去的方面应以学校历史课的形式正式传授给下一代。

a1790f1d99063c5fecbd9c0b5e3a11a12b745b94.en: Urban forests can show pride and community spirit.
a1790f1d99063c5fecbd9c0b5e3a11a12b745b94.zh: 城市森林可以展现自豪感和社区精神。

bc0624920b79789bde814e2da407587ca91fea29.en: Trees enhance community economic stability by attracting businesses and tourism.
bc0624920b79789bde814e2da407587ca91fea29.zh: 树木通过吸引企业和旅游业来增强社区的经济稳定性。

d4ff72dfcf345b10d79a10a139256cf47dabcd1d.en: People linger and shop longer along tree - lined streets, apartments and offices in wooded areas, rent more quickly and have higher occupancy rates.
d4ff72dfcf345b10d79a10a139256cf47dabcd1d.zh: 人们在林荫道旁逗留更久、购物时间更长；有树林的公寓和办公室出租更快，入住率更高。

f715154f74d08c11a3f222b33511212ee6b988db.en: Businesses leasing office space and developed developments with trees find their workers are more productive and absenteeism is reduced.
f715154f74d08c11a3f222b33511212ee6b988db.zh: 租赁带有树木的办公空间并开发相关项目的企业发现，其员工生产力更高，缺勤率降低。

8e6721c10ddc46a5edf4a20f946565bbc1e5da75.en: The natural environment can be hazardous, and, with increased travel and leisure, people today are more likely than ever to be exposed to potentially life-threatening conditions.
8e6721c10ddc46a5edf4a20f946565bbc1e5da75.zh: 自然环境充满危险，随着旅行和休闲活动的增加，如今人们暴露于潜在致命环境中的可能性比以往任何时候都大。

34aee244b6b9030bf2675aef83b7b4a35a878188.en: Although the human body can adjust to some extent, it cannot cope with poisons or prolonged exposure to extremes of environment.
34aee244b6b9030bf2675aef83b7b4a35a878188.zh: 尽管人体能在一定程度上适应环境，但它无法应对毒素或长期暴露在极端环境中。

5c8459a97c1c27d918c897b610581def2d6674d1.en: Hundreds of millions of people eat fast food every day without giving it too much thought.
5c8459a97c1c27d918c897b610581def2d6674d1.zh: 每天有数亿人吃快餐，却对此不加过多思考。

f09afee44354cb9f0b9a5edc3cfc8aa95404754d.en: They just unwrap their hamburgers and dig in.
f09afee44354cb9f0b9a5edc3cfc8aa95404754d.zh: 他们只是拆开汉堡包装就开始大吃起来。

5a8095abc7c716de2f09f2e83ed36f427c909522.en: An hour or so later, when the burger's all gone and the wrapper's been tossed into the garbage, the whole meal has already been forgotten.
5a8095abc7c716de2f09f2e83ed36f427c909522.zh: 大约一小时后，当汉堡被吃完、包装纸被扔进垃圾桶时，这顿饭早已被人遗忘。

a41d24f22efc24129edb059d58268f3c224ef929.en: One is to cope with the great weight of huge grinding cheek teeth and elongated tusk teeth, making the skull particularly massive.
a41d24f22efc24129edb059d58268f3c224ef929.zh: 其一是为了承受巨大的研磨颊齿和延长的獠牙所带来的巨大重量，这使得头骨特别庞大。

55b7c6dba8c6a385ffff762ff58bdb59e7fe6708.en: We are all unique as learners, although some patterns emerge any groups of students.
55b7c6dba8c6a385ffff762ff58bdb59e7fe6708.zh: 作为学习者，我们每个人都独一无二，尽管在某些学生群体中会出现一些共同的模式。

9f333327ace14aab068704b03fc870b86aa96f2c.en: We seek to improve learner's experience of education at college and help them to aspire, achieve and progress.
9f333327ace14aab068704b03fc870b86aa96f2c.zh: 我们致力于改善大学生在教育方面的体验，并帮助他们树立志向、取得成就并不断进步。

b9c62cafdb20d7530c0122a4bf539a9e686f8385.en: We must embed equality and diversity in everything we do, both as a provider and an employer.
b9c62cafdb20d7530c0122a4bf539a9e686f8385.zh: 我们必须将平等和多样性融入我们所做的每一件事中，无论是作为服务提供者还是雇主。

9dad377a237ceb4dd4df88d0917f2f9cd7a8d170.en: We hope to prepare our students for work, higher education and citizenship by equipping our staff with the skills to meet this agenda.
9dad377a237ceb4dd4df88d0917f2f9cd7a8d170.zh: 我们希望通过赋予员工满足这一议程所需的技能，来帮助学生为工作、高等教育和公民生活做好准备。

7185a40a824903add3f3a4a897d0eb8232b84676.en: The United States is at present the world's market for motor cars and trucks.
7185a40a824903add3f3a4a897d0eb8232b84676.zh: 目前，美国是世界上汽车和卡车最大的市场。

fd48a23568071b466e53184c0071bedda2bc26e7.zh: 美国国内外商业局的一位代理

d1b9e2a82512400828938cb35598164a15217ebb.en: Bureau of Foreign and Domestic Commerce reports a prosperous condition of affairs prevailing in Japan, which is buying more automobiles, especially large cars, than ever before.
d1b9e2a82512400828938cb35598164a15217ebb.zh: 报道称日本商务状况繁荣，其购买的汽车数量前所未有，尤其是大型汽车。

ab19c47c78d2b7ba4fd0d9bf449e72d1b6d4b7d1.en: While blue is one of the most popular colours, it is one of the least appetising.
ab19c47c78d2b7ba4fd0d9bf449e72d1b6d4b7d1.zh: 虽然蓝色是最受欢迎的颜色之一，但它也是最没有食欲的颜色之一。

72568132199cac24781bab42895d8ebeba9ec511.en: Food researchers say that when humans searched for food, they learned to avoid toxic or spoiled objects, which were often blue, black, or purple.
72568132199cac24781bab42895d8ebeba9ec511.zh: 食品研究人员表示，当人类寻找食物时，他们学会了避免有毒或变质的物体，这些物体通常是蓝色、黑色或紫色的。

9393410c8379584656528518b5b87c10df9e0c8e.en: When food dyed blue is served to study subjects, they lose appetite.
9393410c8379584656528518b5b87c10df9e0c8e.zh: 当向受试者提供染成蓝色的食物时，他们会失去食欲。

cca7c93050eae5039106f8bbb68041118f29557c.en: How do we imagine the unimaginable?
cca7c93050eae5039106f8bbb68041118f29557c.zh: 我们如何想象不可想象之物？

2ae85287e6010c7db222d2497ac1a343401d69c3.en: If we are asked to think of an object - say, a yellow tulip - a picture immediately forms in our mind's eye?
2ae85287e6010c7db222d2497ac1a343401d69c3.zh: 如果让我们想一个物体——比如一朵黄色的郁金香——脑海中是否会立刻浮现出它的画面？

39d9d7f69787acda5a7de8a105675ecde46152d9.en: But what if we try to imagine a concept such as the square root of a negative number?
39d9d7f69787acda5a7de8a105675ecde46152d9.zh: 但如果我们要想象一个概念，比如负数的平方根呢？

0cfc8246aaf10ae8d237f19c341a40b00964041a.en: Who do you think is the most glamorous person?
0cfc8246aaf10ae8d237f19c341a40b00964041a.zh: 你认为谁是最有魅力的人？

e209cc250a4abb240e73ef4cca1864b89c33415f.en: A biotechnologist who led his company in international research, an ordinary welder who gained international fame through his work, or a photographer complimented widely for a series of photos?
e209cc250a4abb240e73ef4cca1864b89c33415f.zh: 是领导公司开展国际研究的生物技术学家，还是因工作而享誉国际的普通焊工，或是因一组照片而广受赞誉的摄影师？

45554551004a12531b613fbd862f6361b219e220.en: In the late 16th and 17th centuries, many English, French and Dutch emigrants went to North America in search of gold and silver.
45554551004a12531b613fbd862f6361b219e220.zh: 在16世纪末和17世纪，许多英国、法国和荷兰移民前往北美寻找金银。

915e8eb0de2c23a919d791d8a923c3eb06ef0d3b.en: But they did not find it.

c2e4684393c37c31114f6879ccf4bc902c929b2c.en: Instead, settlers were forced to support themselves by cultivating crops that they could sell in Europe, like tobacco, indigo and rice.
c2e4684393c37c31114f6879ccf4bc902c929b2c.zh: 相反，定居者被迫通过种植可以销往欧洲的作物（如烟草、靛蓝和水稻）来维持生计。

3c35076b80553921ffea3c1e9e3c49946fa9243f.en: Members of a culture must conform to its norms for the culture to exist and function.
3c35076b80553921ffea3c1e9e3c49946fa9243f.zh: 文化的成员必须遵守其规范，文化才能存在并发挥作用。

3842434d09e190bef0b736d430ac5c0068a937f9.en: Hence, members must want to conform and obey rules.
3842434d09e190bef0b736d430ac5c0068a937f9.zh: 因此，成员必须愿意遵守并服从规则。

4db84073f7855f88f4c2600c82009a9600765640.en: They first must internalise the social norms and values that dictate what is normal for the culture.
4db84073f7855f88f4c2600c82009a9600765640.zh: 他们首先必须内化规定何种行为符合该文化常态的社会规范和价值观。

6396d2f1a2045d13a32af309cee8026228cb54ad.en: Then they must socialise or teach norms and values to their children.
6396d2f1a2045d13a32af309cee8026228cb54ad.zh: 然后，他们必须通过社会化过程或直接向子女传授这些规范和价值观。

0921173c08c0eb59d841404668342ac1b4657294.en: The world's fifth largest continent: Antarctica is almost entirely covered by ice over 2000 metres thick.
0921173c08c0eb59d841404668342ac1b4657294.zh: 世界第五大洲南极洲几乎完全被超过2000米厚的冰层覆盖。

f41710556618a13892c8e9b5f420e1ceef911658.en: There were various explanations for volcano behaviour before the structure of the earth mantle as a semisolid material was developed.
f41710556618a13892c8e9b5f420e1ceef911658.zh: 在地球地幔作为半固态物质的结构理论确立之前，人们对火山活动有多种解释。

ade9600d3c2c55a151030b7061e67e30fcb0b309.en: For decades, awareness that compression and radioactive materials may be heat sources was discounted and volcanic action was often attributed to chemical reactions and a thin layer of molten rock near the surface.
ade9600d3c2c55a151030b7061e67e30fcb0b309.zh: 数十年来，人们忽视了压缩作用和放射性物质可能作为热源的观点，火山活动常被归因于化学反应以及地表附近的一层薄熔融岩石。

90bdb995375b91678d275fc12f0f11c187f8ea70.en: You see neighbours tending their gardens and children walking to school.
90bdb995375b91678d275fc12f0f11c187f8ea70.zh: 你看到邻居们在打理花园，孩子们走在上学的路上。

e1214fd0b71f6d0095c7562c3ad7c18171f57201.en: What if the answer turned out to be that they had always been there, you just hadn't seen them?
e1214fd0b71f6d0095c7562c3ad7c18171f57201.zh: 如果答案是他们一直就在那里，只是你没看见呢？

cd042ea32df5a1bb3395576707a1c4f62aca3fea.en: The shell is made of bone and is a dull brown colour.
cd042ea32df5a1bb3395576707a1c4f62aca3fea.zh: 外壳由骨骼构成，呈暗棕色。

1f6a6d9ddf182d88900a3f819f072051ba13b487.en: Sleep behaviour is also known as a sleep disorder.
1f6a6d9ddf182d88900a3f819f072051ba13b487.zh: 睡眠行为也被称为睡眠障碍。

6735adad434c68e0a0b23fb396a1e8c34b2cf8b3.en: People with sleep disorders often talk or walk in their sleep.
6735adad434c68e0a0b23fb396a1e8c34b2cf8b3.zh: 患有睡眠障碍的人经常在睡眠中说话或行走。

85e78ef64068a657e0dc7234d31a6516b188c121.en: There aren't any serious effects on the body in general but it may be connected to mental health.
85e78ef64068a657e0dc7234d31a6516b188c121.zh: 对身体的整体影响不大，但它可能与心理健康有关。

15950de03ec6daf1d149e2bf601608bca9be1157.en: People with childhood trauma, unspeakable problems or depression are the ones with different sleep behaviours.
15950de03ec6daf1d149e2bf601608bca9be1157.zh: 有童年创伤、难以启齿的问题或抑郁症的人往往表现出不同的睡眠行为。

daba97c12ea4ba3f5bb5a357c2df4eed173f1487.en: Statistics are indicators of change and allow meaningful comparisons to be made.
daba97c12ea4ba3f5bb5a357c2df4eed173f1487.zh: 统计数据是变化的指标，有助于进行有意义的比较。

9c7d3f13c13883f171d46198c72b32da283938d2.en: While it may be the issues rather than the statistics as such that grab people's attention, it should be recognised that it is the statistics that informed the issues.
9c7d3f13c13883f171d46198c72b32da283938d2.zh: 虽然吸引人们注意力的可能是问题本身而非统计数据，但应认识到正是统计数据揭示了这些问题。

91e75f0c8531e65f3ed380a5bd06dd704f2fd685.en: Statistical literacy, then, is the ability to accurately understand, interpret and evaluate the data that inform these issues.
91e75f0c8531e65f3ed380a5bd06dd704f2fd685.zh: 因此，统计素养是指准确理解、解释和评估为这些问题提供依据的数据的能力。

5ce2ae674dd424446e0f6ed70d5b73614d6c8c02.en: The bill calls for the establishment of the National Landslide Hazards Reduction Programme within one year of becoming law.
5ce2ae674dd424446e0f6ed70d5b73614d6c8c02.zh: 该法案要求在成为法律后一年内建立国家滑坡灾害减少计划。

ae5f4a2499100f99a7d6cbb38ef2277c36c106b8.en: The programme serves numerous functions, including to identify and understand landslide hazards and risks, reduce losses from landslides, protect communities at risk of landslides hazards, and improve communication and emergency preparedness.
ae5f4a2499100f99a7d6cbb38ef2277c36c106b8.zh: 该计划具有多种功能，包括识别和理解滑坡灾害与风险、减少滑坡造成的损失、保护面临滑坡灾害风险的社区，以及改善沟通和应急准备。

bde649b46987c8269722f4142af2094493a463db.en: The networks of roots that plants used to absorb water and nutrients can encompass a space larger than the part of the plant visible above ground.
bde649b46987c8269722f4142af2094493a463db.zh: 植物用于吸收水分和养分的根系网络所覆盖的空间，可能大于植物露出地面的可见部分。

816c0defec8fb26728ac3a3a655bcfee0b586ee4.en: The nature of these roots systems can help plants adapt to challenging environments such as deserts.
816c0defec8fb26728ac3a3a655bcfee0b586ee4.zh: 这些根系的结构有助于植物适应沙漠等恶劣环境。

4391cd229cd017a100557ecf3c58e1eb194e1f27.en: The word radical from the Latin word for roots means anyone who advocates fundamental change in the political system.
4391cd229cd017a100557ecf3c58e1eb194e1f27.zh: “radical”一词源自拉丁语中表示“根”的词，指任何主张对政治体制进行根本性变革的人。

ccc80ebf01f727f37e82d764bbc57b4bfbf81cac.en: Literally, a radical is one who proposes to attack some political or social problem by going deep into the social or economic fabric to get at the root cause and alter this basic weakness.
ccc80ebf01f727f37e82d764bbc57b4bfbf81cac.zh: 字面上看，激进主义者是指通过深入社会或经济结构以触及根本原因并改变这一基本弱点，从而提出解决某些政治或社会问题方案的人。

5f5024d6162d06b66fe47095ab9681b85787801d.en: The key is to use quotes to support a point you're trying to make rather than just include them to fill the space.
5f5024d6162d06b66fe47095ab9681b85787801d.zh: 关键在于使用引文来支持你试图提出的观点，而不是仅仅为了填充篇幅而引用。

c1e69ca5a102e3ac49d5475e129c0eaa0eb51567.en: We can see from the X-rays that at an early stage of painting, a window was painted at the left of the portrait.
c1e69ca5a102e3ac49d5475e129c0eaa0eb51567.zh: 从X光片中可以看出，在绘画的早期阶段，肖像画的左侧曾画有一扇窗户。

a6029ee87d34a116cd04dd8e300c3567e05df2c5.en: It seems that there may have been two windows in the initial design for the portrait or that the window was moved at an early stage.
a6029ee87d34a116cd04dd8e300c3567e05df2c5.zh: 看来，这幅肖像画的初始设计中可能有两扇窗户，或者是在早期阶段将窗户的位置进行了移动。

df3d7fc2dde8b2a68fb6399c2622507d20197905.en: Within this free course, you will be introduced briefly to the discipline of child psychology and to theories and approaches that have been developed to help us understand and support children's lives by focusing on the individual children.
df3d7fc2dde8b2a68fb6399c2622507d20197905.zh: 在本免费课程中，您将简要了解儿童心理学这一学科，以及为帮助我们关注个体儿童从而理解和支持其生活而发展的各种理论和方法。

c778d502621ff4aef58d34b3250af2fa3ee7f9fb.en: Psychologists can assess changes in their child's abilities over time, including their physical, cognitive, social, and emotional development.
c778d502621ff4aef58d34b3250af2fa3ee7f9fb.zh: 心理学家可以评估儿童能力随时间的变化，包括其身体、认知、社交和情感发展。

72ce9bc78542615ac7caa07a785827da2273049b.en: The course considers the ways in which thinkers have responded to the particular political problems of their day, and the ways in which they contribute to a broader conversation about human goods and needs, justice, democracy, and the proper relationship of the individual to the state.
72ce9bc78542615ac7caa07a785827da2273049b.zh: 本课程探讨了思想家们如何回应其所处时代的特定政治问题，以及他们如何参与关于人类福祉与需求、正义、民主以及个人与国家之间适当关系的更广泛讨论。

486c822980165267ec18fcd5c459f46c327d23d5.en: To some extent, attendance at cultural venues and events is influenced by a person's age and the composition of the household in which they live.
486c822980165267ec18fcd5c459f46c327d23d5.zh: 在某种程度上，参观文化场所和参加活动受到个人年龄及其居住家庭构成的影响。

b01b34de43ebe6efccf6c159b5b88ec68824e006.en: For example, those people in households with dependent children were more likely to visit zoological parks and aquariums than people living in single person households.
b01b34de43ebe6efccf6c159b5b88ec68824e006.zh: 例如，有未成年子女的家庭成员比独居者更有可能去动物园和水族馆。

1e636f43431b65bbc2465a59c99e4db1086d66d3.en: At a time when stress levels are soaring, rates of depression are increasing and the gap between rich and poor is ever widening.
1e636f43431b65bbc2465a59c99e4db1086d66d3.zh: 在压力水平飙升、抑郁症发病率上升以及贫富差距不断扩大的当下。

24f149ecfbaffdef2b283234a7e422435ad04034.en: We believe that giving can play a positive role in helping people to feel connected to those around them and generate a sense of purpose and hope.
24f149ecfbaffdef2b283234a7e422435ad04034.zh: 我们相信，给予可以帮助人们与周围的人建立联系，并产生目标感和希望，从而发挥积极作用。

a800fa56f353f057ae94a525b4e2683ba9a2a6c5.en: When we give, we feel valued, useful and happy.
a800fa56f353f057ae94a525b4e2683ba9a2a6c5.zh: 当我们给予时，我们会感到被重视、有用和快乐。

7f99f2f247bc0c81d895c34e8c93dc65a4563ad0.en: Blue whales are the largest living mammals.
7f99f2f247bc0c81d895c34e8c93dc65a4563ad0.zh: 蓝鲸是现存最大的哺乳动物。

3997315a8a619cc48e7ec6bfab23f19e70cfc32e.en: Though reports of maximum length and weight vary from one account to another, Antarctic blue whales are known to have reached lengths to 100 feet, and weights of over 150 tonnes before stocks were severely depleted by whaling operations.
3997315a8a619cc48e7ec6bfab23f19e70cfc32e.zh: 尽管关于最大长度和体重的报道因来源而异，但已知南极蓝鲸在捕鲸活动导致其种群严重枯竭之前，体长曾达到100英尺，体重超过150吨。

6b4e4ba99a8ea00f58fe045b606c6b8149e80492.en: Regular exercise releases brain chemicals key for memory, concentration, and mental sharpness at the same time as lifting your mood, and lowering stress and anxiety all of which contribute to brain health.
6b4e4ba99a8ea00f58fe045b606c6b8149e80492.zh: 规律的运动能释放对记忆、专注力和思维敏捷性至关重要的脑部化学物质，同时提升情绪，降低压力和焦虑，所有这些都有助于大脑健康。

35d51e06b9a4d78b7465a11dc2185f84d37ade0e.en: Studies show that regular exercise helps you manage complex tasks, organise and razor - sharpen your focus which is great for those long revision sessions or particularly complex exam questions.
35d51e06b9a4d78b7465a11dc2185f84d37ade0e.zh: 研究表明，规律的运动有助于你管理复杂任务，组织思路并 sharpen（ sharpen 此处意为“使更敏锐”）你的注意力，这对长时间的复习或特别复杂的考试题目非常有益。

b3774d7b5c5829e049ae48ac7290ab2b5c4a9894.en: Another administration option is to bake marijuana at a relatively low temperature to kill any dangerous microorganisms and then allow that patient to eat it or drink it.
b3774d7b5c5829e049ae48ac7290ab2b5c4a9894.zh: 另一种给药方式是相对低温烘烤大麻以杀死任何危险的微生物，然后让患者食用或饮用它。

441a7986a31fc06f64f63a87914701e8a9c6ec2c.en: Both of these methods of administration make smoking the drug unnecessary.
441a7986a31fc06f64f63a87914701e8a9c6ec2c.zh: 这两种给药方式都使得吸烟给药变得不必要。

86eeeca3c35de65938f1a354f0095a7bc6753186.en: However, criticism of medical marijuana has also been raised because as a natural plant, it cannot be patented and marketed by pharmaceutical companies and is unlikely to win widespread medical acceptance.
86eeeca3c35de65938f1a354f0095a7bc6753186.zh: 然而，对医用大麻的批评也随之而来，因为作为一种天然植物，它无法被制药公司申请专利并进行市场推广，也不太可能获得广泛的医学认可。

81ce9ff094fc43df58839532a4f4306381c953bc.en: The climate for doing business improved in Egypt more than in any other country last year, according to a global study that revealed a wave of company-oriented reforms across the Middle East.
81ce9ff094fc43df58839532a4f4306381c953bc.zh: 根据一项揭示中东地区出现一波以企业为导向的改革浪潮的全球研究，埃及去年的营商环境改善程度超过世界上任何其他国家的。

dab94a0708a2806fa90d280bdb2d4de601f4e895.en: The World Bank rankings, which look at business regulations, also showed that the pace of business reforms in Eastern Europe was overtaking East Asia.
dab94a0708a2806fa90d280bdb2d4de601f4e895.zh: 考察商业法规的世界银行排名还显示，东欧的商业改革步伐正在超越东亚。

3368a53e7199d13971b40809c43384cf9f321475.en: The main production of soft drink was started in 1830' s.
3368a53e7199d13971b40809c43384cf9f321475.zh: 软饮料的主要生产始于19世纪30年代。

b995eb4918565ac303f0eb83fc8add7fc0a6f1e8.en: Since then, from those experimental beginning, there was an evolution until in 1781 when the world's first cola - flavoured beverage was introduced.
b995eb4918565ac303f0eb83fc8add7fc0a6f1e8.zh: 此后，从这些实验性的开端开始，经历了一系列演变，直到1781年世界上第一款可乐味饮料问世。

8d17cc7f6c6028c012bb03e74cbc882d757b09e4.en: These drinks were called soft drinks, only to separate them from hard alcoholic drinks.
8d17cc7f6c6028c012bb03e74cbc882d757b09e4.zh: 这些饮料被称为软饮料，只是为了将它们与烈性酒精饮料区分开来。

a1cb026b7121c5083d408515150411b57dc4d161.en: Today, soft drink is more favourite refreshment drink than tea, coffee, juice, etc.
a1cb026b7121c5083d408515150411b57dc4d161.zh: 如今，软饮料比茶、咖啡、果汁等更受人们喜爱，成为最受欢迎的清凉饮品。

a101890c186d7586a4f6ed64340a0280c6f0b08f.en: While it is considered an optimistic colour, people lose their tempers more often in yellow rooms, and babies will cry more.
a101890c186d7586a4f6ed64340a0280c6f0b08f.zh: 虽然黄色被视为一种乐观的颜色，但人们在黄色房间里更容易发脾气，婴儿也更容易哭闹。

75a13233e637e516e2402176d911c6e20af2ed4c.en: It is the most difficult colour for the eye to take in, so it can be overpowering if overused.
75a13233e637e516e2402176d911c6e20af2ed4c.zh: 这是眼睛最难适应的颜色，因此如果过度使用，会显得过于刺眼。

4c0d2b39c4f4aaab41ae480a730288877f053a32.en: If bonus or " incentive pay " schemes work so well for senior executives and bankers, why does everyone not get them?
4c0d2b39c4f4aaab41ae480a730288877f053a32.zh: 如果奖金或“激励薪酬”计划对高层管理人员和银行家如此有效，为什么不是所有人都能获得这些奖励？

159f67ebcd5c1b74acf8401f1ab307c253fa3b8a.en: After all, many jobs involve making important decisions or taking risks.
159f67ebcd5c1b74acf8401f1ab307c253fa3b8a.zh: 毕竟，许多工作都涉及做出重要决策或承担风险。

121c39f00ded5d432de792f6fcea4b116219c441.en: Is there anything about corporate decisions and financial risks that makes these categories of work special in terms of how they need to be incentivized and rewarded?
121c39f00ded5d432de792f6fcea4b116219c441.zh: 企业决策和金融风险方面有什么特殊之处，使得这些类别的工作在激励和回报方式上显得与众不同吗？

1bdb6a8a9f1bacbf95a87e6aea8df9bb3db69558.en: Association between meatless diet and depression: participants who excluded meat from their diet were found to have a higher prevalence of depressive episodes as compared to participants who consumed meat.
1bdb6a8a9f1bacbf95a87e6aea8df9bb3db69558.zh: 无肉饮食与抑郁症之间的关联：研究发现，与食用肉类的人相比，排除肉类的人群中抑郁发作的患病率更高。

13f7cc415ff263a8fe9dbd104f3a1f7a00971137.en: This association is independent of socioeconomic, lifestyle factors, and nutrient deficiencies.
13f7cc415ff263a8fe9dbd104f3a1f7a00971137.zh: 这种关联独立于社会经济状况、生活方式因素以及营养缺乏之外。

23e54c745aff86fe198de12ad24aa05b9a3d2a89.en: Cats are popular pets around the world.
23e54c745aff86fe198de12ad24aa05b9a3d2a89.zh: 猫是世界各地受欢迎的宠物。

80bad14a2fc3f68e00ef7c672bdd572b1f2dcac5.en: They are known for their playful nature, soft fur, and independent personalities.
80bad14a2fc3f68e00ef7c672bdd572b1f2dcac5.zh: 它们以活泼的天性、柔软的皮毛和独立的个性而闻名。

02772f8573ff0dfa37381706a63a8b93d9a0fca6.en: Many people enjoy having cats as companions, as they can provide comfort and entertainment.
02772f8573ff0dfa37381706a63a8b93d9a0fca6.zh: 许多人喜欢把猫当作伴侣，因为它们能带来安慰和乐趣。

83978d13928c4962aa6d3a4993a41e0b9c0df5c2.en: However, it is important to take care of cats properly by providing them with food, water, and regular veterinary check - ups.
83978d13928c4962aa6d3a4993a41e0b9c0df5c2.zh: 然而，正确照顾猫咪很重要，需要为它们提供食物、水以及定期的兽医检查。

4ded2b546b341c4a42e851323baa0b2bebbffdcd.en: When a male African savanna elephant folds his ears while simultaneously waving them, he's ready for a fight.
4ded2b546b341c4a42e851323baa0b2bebbffdcd.zh: 当雄性非洲草原象同时折叠并挥动耳朵时，它准备战斗。

17ddf3d528fd9f196a19645b5b4dbce1f143a8a6.en: When a female folds her ears and accompanies the action with an ear flap, that means she's also issuing a serious threat.
17ddf3d528fd9f196a19645b5b4dbce1f143a8a6.zh: 当雌性折叠耳朵并伴随耳部拍打动作时，意味着它也发出了严重的威胁信号。

195c8573e88c3025397aee3d61301db928c0b6eb.en: But when elephants come together and fold their ears, the animals are expressing a warm greeting.
195c8573e88c3025397aee3d61301db928c0b6eb.zh: 但当大象聚在一起并折叠耳朵时，它们是在表达热情的问候。

45ea0528314403da624fb31f658257a18646c4b3.en: More and more people are choosing to live in cities.
45ea0528314403da624fb31f658257a18646c4b3.zh: 越来越多的人选择生活在城市里。

efb18b67fc425182c739536d28a5fd8c38481d59.en: They offer better opportunities, better services, and sanctuary from conflict and the effects of climate change influences.
efb18b67fc425182c739536d28a5fd8c38481d59.zh: 它们提供更好的机会、更好的服务，以及远离冲突和气候变化影响的庇护所。

41f2289faf3bcfefab5ada912eb9241e949d7c0f.en: Yet large numbers of people are unable for various reasons to move to cities-skills is matches, reluctance to sell land at a loss, and sometimes because of explicit policy restrictions that limit people's movement within countries.
41f2289faf3bcfefab5ada912eb9241e949d7c0f.zh: 然而，由于各种原因，大量人无法迁往城市——技能不匹配、不愿亏本出售土地，有时还因为限制国内人口流动的政策规定。

7503c3d21d94f08842ea9ec591a45e3e29feb61c.en: Such an agreement would include recognition that the world must aim as soon as possible to hold global warming to 1.5-degree Celsius; a long-term low-carbon future; 5-year updated action plans that recognise the developing climate reality; and aid to those countries that did little to cause climate change but are most at risk from it.
7503c3d21d94f08842ea9ec591a45e3e29feb61c.zh: 此类协议将包括承认世界必须尽快将全球升温控制在1.5摄氏度以内；实现长期的低碳未来；制定承认当前气候现实的五年更新行动计划；以及向那些对气候变化负有责任较小但风险最高的国家提供援助。

37bebfb3735c5af232182f6941fba0d0d1e82f2b.en: This time the University is running a series of workshops for final year students on how to do well in interviews.
37bebfb3735c5af232182f6941fba0d0d1e82f2b.zh: 此次，大学为应届毕业生举办了一系列关于如何在面试中取得优异成绩的工作坊。

adafaf2b7ba5da6eeb6b32020a8e3d69b87de09a.en: These sessions will help participants prepare effectively for and perform at their best during later job interviews.
adafaf2b7ba5da6eeb6b32020a8e3d69b87de09a.zh: 这些课程将帮助参与者有效准备并在随后的求职面试中发挥最佳水平。

3ce8551b5d5312d033ae4cf8191b1033a1a77984.en: The workshop tutors have an excellent record of success in helping students acquire the positions they desire.
3ce8551b5d5312d033ae4cf8191b1033a1a77984.zh: 工作坊导师在帮助学生获得理想职位方面有着出色的成功记录。

837002d89d5036a477695babeaa1cf113c635117.en: This study tracked about one thousand adults in the United States, and they ranged in age from 34 to 93, and they started the study by asking,' How much stress have you experienced in the last year?
837002d89d5036a477695babeaa1cf113c635117.zh: 这项研究追踪了美国约一千名成年人，他们的年龄从34岁到93岁不等，研究开始时询问他们：“你在过去一年中经历了多少压力？”

f26a19e1b3ecf0297845e9fda3e7277c204cfcbc.en: They also asked, How much time have you spent helping out friends, neighbours, people in your community?
f26a19e1b3ecf0297845e9fda3e7277c204cfcbc.zh: 他们还询问：“你花了多少时间帮助朋友、邻居和社区里的人？”

aabe42ce63704ccac7264cf5766b39a23081dcae.en: And then they used public records for the next five years to find out who died.
aabe42ce63704ccac7264cf5766b39a23081dcae.zh: 然后，他们利用未来五年的公共记录来查明谁去世了。

887406036baae4166cdaac62a335c5ea8f91f8a8.en: Television is bound to have a tremendous impact on a child.
887406036baae4166cdaac62a335c5ea8f91f8a8.zh: 电视必然会对孩子产生巨大的影响。

ed0831931313cbb730b851c1af5a3f16c2bb345a.en: When a parent is concerned about the effects of television, he should consider several things: what TV offers the child in terms of information and knowledge, how many hours a week a youngster his age should watch television, the impact of violence and sex, and the influence of commercials.
ed0831931313cbb730b851c1af5a3f16c2bb345a.zh: 当父母担心电视对孩子的影响时，他们应该考虑几个方面：电视在信息和知识方面为孩子提供了什么、同龄孩子每周应该看多少小时电视、暴力和性内容的影响，以及广告的影响。

343f0ffb7662191c31da2eb10f26896da44e441f.en: An innovative new product or service can give a firm a head start over its rivals, which can be difficult for a new entrant to overcome.
343f0ffb7662191c31da2eb10f26896da44e441f.zh: 一款创新的新产品或服务可以让企业领先于竞争对手，而这种优势对于新进入者来说往往难以克服。

60d3f624e8d04e91854962b803d2e51a139704d2.en: If the new technology is also patented, then other firms cannot simply copy its design.
60d3f624e8d04e91854962b803d2e51a139704d2.zh: 如果这项新技术也获得了专利，那么其他公司就不能简单地复制其设计。

f44bb589b46b01b00f5f843cec1d139ea2e77fd6.en: The development of easy-to-use statistics is being taught and learned.
f44bb589b46b01b00f5f843cec1d139ea2e77fd6.zh: 易于使用的统计软件的开发正在被教授和学习。

c3b447f14053078631edc9a48133c11744a81ec3.en: Students can make transformations of variables, create graphs of distributions of variables, and select among statistical analyses all at the click of a button.
c3b447f14053078631edc9a48133c11744a81ec3.zh: 学生只需点击一下按钮，就可以对变量进行转换、创建变量的分布图，并选择统计分析方法。

6acf468f6d01f99d413452f02cc588fc7d97efc0.en: However, even with these advancements, students sometimes find statistics to be an arduous task.
6acf468f6d01f99d413452f02cc588fc7d97efc0.zh: 然而，即使有这些进步，学生们有时仍觉得统计学是一项艰巨的任务。

ff73555f5e8f064c777dde11f65b3331da5cfe21.en: Parents attend school conference for their children.
ff73555f5e8f064c777dde11f65b3331da5cfe21.zh: 父母参加学校的家长会以了解孩子的情况。

e0cbec5c3c51f93d23a1ff35709256944e57dabd.en: Your child has the opportunity to meet with parents 4 times a year to understand the child's progress and prepare questions in advance.
e0cbec5c3c51f93d23a1ff35709256944e57dabd.zh: 您的孩子每年有四次机会与家长会面，了解孩子的学习进展并提前准备问题。

ed6855af2df9e117ba1139abe091202f333396cc.en: Many people believe that employers discriminate against older people because youths have more energy and creativity.
ed6855af2df9e117ba1139abe091202f333396cc.zh: 许多人认为雇主对年长者存在歧视，因为年轻人更有活力和创造力。

fb640f51e9681d458b21f12ed31922278b087abb.en: The main reason for hiring younger workers is payroll.
fb640f51e9681d458b21f12ed31922278b087abb.zh: 雇佣年轻员工的主要原因是薪资成本。

43a220f461d3a0cc08521d71653d7214baf37466.en: In most countries, your salary is dependent on how many years of work experience you have.
43a220f461d3a0cc08521d71653d7214baf37466.zh: 在大多数国家，您的薪水取决于您拥有多少年的工作经验。

48e91a61b20d3443669ac7e2fad5dbbac2bd64ec.en: It is far more cost efficient to hire postgraduates, fresh out of university, than senior staff with over twenty years of industry knowledge.
48e91a61b20d3443669ac7e2fad5dbbac2bd64ec.zh: 与拥有二十年以上行业经验的高级员工相比，聘用刚大学毕业的研究生更具成本效益。

3f54e833c2f1fc1be4a94fb95cf97f9ec27380ae.en: Located at the heart of two world famous cities, Liverpool and London, Liverpool's excellence in teaching, learning and research, first - class facilities and outstanding support places the university in the top 1 percent of universities worldwide.
3f54e833c2f1fc1be4a94fb95cf97f9ec27380ae.zh: 坐落于世界名城利物浦和伦敦的中心地带，凭借卓越的教学、学习与研究实力、一流的设施以及出色的支持服务，该大学跻身全球前百分之一的高校行列。

1c100394af654d4d65ac6f3c0479d926e41e4e58.en: There are three main interpretations of the English Revolution.
1c100394af654d4d65ac6f3c0479d926e41e4e58.zh: 关于英国革命主要有三种解释。

831c8bb8658b3ba1df514c7cec853e7650561bca.en: The longest lasting interpretation was that the Revolution was an almost inevitable outcome of an age old power struggle between parliament and crown.
831c8bb8658b3ba1df514c7cec853e7650561bca.zh: 持续时间最长的解释认为，这场革命是议会与王权之间古老权力斗争几乎不可避免的产物。

c2b3afab764d55e264c40ec582ec3bdfb9781ac1.en: The second sees it as a class struggle, and a lead up to the French and other revolutions.
c2b3afab764d55e264c40ec582ec3bdfb9781ac1.zh: 第二种观点将其视为一场阶级斗争，并看作是法国及其他革命的序曲。

3ccd9e38170ccfb08a5281bc32b84966a6757c00.en: Finally, the third interpretation sees the other two as too fixed, not allowing for unpredictability, and that the outcome could have gone either way.
3ccd9e38170ccfb08a5281bc32b84966a6757c00.zh: 最后，第三种观点认为前两种观点过于僵化，未考虑到不可预测性，且结果本可能朝任一方向发展。

24cddd2c419e3c67e321b65da53aaa3d60b0a5cf.en: Vitamin D deficiency linked to premature death.
24cddd2c419e3c67e321b65da53aaa3d60b0a5cf.zh: 维生素D缺乏与早逝有关。

d29759e6b29a42c3d8c2710d5c6c5faaf9e7bed1.en: Over a 14 - year follow - up period, researchers found that the risk for death significantly decreased with increased vitamin D concentrations, with the strongest effects seen among those with severe deficiencies.
d29759e6b29a42c3d8c2710d5c6c5faaf9e7bed1.zh: 在长达14年的随访期间，研究人员发现，随着维生素D水平的升高，死亡风险显著降低，其中严重缺乏者受益最大。

b3fd0ba1cd7e868b199af3afd8d3786471b782e0.en: One of the unidentifiable objects in this study lies just outside Centaurus NGC 5128, an elliptical galaxy located about 12 million light-years from Earth.
b3fd0ba1cd7e868b199af3afd8d3786471b782e0.zh: 这项研究中一个无法识别的天体位于半人马座NGC 5128之外，这是一颗距离地球约1200万光年的椭圆星系。

3f710c46431319e366d4149e056413e90841d12b.en: The other is in a globular cluster of stars found just outside NGC 4636, another elliptical galaxy located 47 million light-years from Earth in the constellation Virgo.
3f710c46431319e366d4149e056413e90841d12b.zh: 另一个天体位于NGC 4636之外的一个球状星团中，NGC 4636是位于室女座、距离地球4700万光年的另一颗椭圆星系。

b75ae6e9bd047fb1778c3114fdbd5141640de8ae.en: Agricultural problems due to climate change of normal weather, water depletion and the collapse of soil have become big problems in all parts of the world.
b75ae6e9bd047fb1778c3114fdbd5141640de8ae.zh: 由于气候异常、水资源枯竭和土壤退化导致的农业问题已成为全球各地的重大难题。

4b77b5168600a7311030f89e8e60ef966d02440f.en: Many are now focusing on ethics and family farming as a way to combat these issues.
4b77b5168600a7311030f89e8e60ef966d02440f.zh: 许多人现在正将重点放在伦理和家庭农业上，以此作为应对这些问题的途径。

bf57f183dea31391e1f10f24cd3859d51e2eec5a.en: But on May third, a couple of weeks later, Lincoln issued an executive order calling for 43,000 three-year volunteers for the army, and also increasing the size of the regular army and navy by 40000 men.
bf57f183dea31391e1f10f24cd3859d51e2eec5a.zh: 但在两周后的5月3日，林肯发布了一项行政命令，征召4.3万名服役期为三年的志愿兵加入军队，并将正规军和海军的规模扩大4万人。

cb161b1acb727ec6085056367780d1a01a0c99fb.en: Both of these actions were in apparent violation of the constitution.
cb161b1acb727ec6085056367780d1a01a0c99fb.zh: 这两项行动显然违反了宪法。

57205df94ddde91cea6954bc55251dd678467ac7.en: Howard believed that all clouds belonged to three distinct groups: cumulus, stratus and cirrus.
57205df94ddde91cea6954bc55251dd678467ac7.zh: 霍华德认为所有云层都属于三个不同的类别：积云、层云和卷云。

a1b225f0ce8321b75385b99f46b16634161a7ec4.en: He added a fourth category, nimbus, to describe a cloud in the act of condensation into rain, hail or snow.
a1b225f0ce8321b75385b99f46b16634161a7ec4.zh: 他增加了第四个类别“雨云”，用来描述正在凝结成雨、冰雹或雪的云。

84e5a925a7201c803447cc34fc7d40c3fafd8837.en: It is by observing how clouds change colour and shape that weather can be predicted, and as long as it is the first three of cloud to keep their normal shape there won't be any rain.
84e5a925a7201c803447cc34fc7d40c3fafd8837.zh: 通过观察云层颜色和形状的变化可以预测天气，只要前三种云保持其正常形状，就不会下雨。

a4bce2b66d177c6dd3700cda3e2c14360187e18d.en: Like coffee, plain tea contains just a couple of calories per cup and no sugar.
a4bce2b66d177c6dd3700cda3e2c14360187e18d.zh: 与咖啡一样，纯茶每杯仅含少量卡路里且不含糖。

c14e346292e8333a7f1b845ca813d35478f4e9a0.en: But what's added in it can change that situation.
c14e346292e8333a7f1b845ca813d35478f4e9a0.zh: 但加入其中的东西可能会改变这一状况。

33fe7cac9dfa147aa1539ff347fb1b00c13f5b36.en: A medium sweet tea and a large iced latte from fast food restaurants both pack about seven teaspoons of sugar.
33fe7cac9dfa147aa1539ff347fb1b00c13f5b36.zh: 快餐店的中杯甜茶和大杯冰拿铁都含有约七茶匙的糖。

79dd8b81890f29a75eba0d1fd8fa53d524cd69c3.en: However, the American Heart Association recommends no more than six teaspoons for the whole day.
79dd8b81890f29a75eba0d1fd8fa53d524cd69c3.zh: 然而，美国心脏协会建议全天摄入量不超过六茶匙。

9900fbc18ebf688848dde6f980f63ca4c1432bd8.en: Children as young as 14 months old will spontaneously help others for no reward.
9900fbc18ebf688848dde6f980f63ca4c1432bd8.zh: 年仅14个月的幼儿就会自发地无偿帮助他人。

a24c8ea893d0a1c2b6fb13477c963a6c3fbf184e.en: But a study of 3-to-5-year-olds found that, although they would spontaneously draw pictures, if they were given a reward for drawing pictures, then later they wouldn't make any drawings unless a reward was offered.
a24c8ea893d0a1c2b6fb13477c963a6c3fbf184e.zh: 但一项针对3至5岁儿童的研究发现，虽然他们会自发地画画，但如果因画画而获得奖励，之后在没有奖励的情况下他们就不会再画画了。

d760076ebf7cd10d8c0d73acb8226fd30ee712d2.en: For graduates looking to give something back, volunteering, either in the UK or overseas, is a popular option.
d760076ebf7cd10d8c0d73acb8226fd30ee712d2.zh: 对于希望回馈社会的毕业生来说，无论是在英国还是海外做志愿者都是一个受欢迎的选择。

30370c10d1bc4a4a504fea7fdeb83619324b570d.en: Voluntary projects can cost anything from nothing up to a few thousand pounds, and with that in mind it is essential to look into the project carefully before signing on the dotted line.
30370c10d1bc4a4a504fea7fdeb83619324b570d.zh: 志愿项目的费用从免费到几千英镑不等，因此在此情况下，在签字确认前仔细考察项目至关重要。

df334992fa79ef0512fc4ab704ab4e72f0ffe8f6.en: Most people believe that overseas experience provides a deeper understanding of cultures and develops communication skills.
df334992fa79ef0512fc4ab704ab4e72f0ffe8f6.zh: 大多数人认为，海外经历能让人更深入地了解文化并提升沟通技巧。

ecf2d6f8db6b52113fa80a3f2d2df470ce669552.en: While this may be true, not all of these new experiences are useful for finding a job.
ecf2d6f8db6b52113fa80a3f2d2df470ce669552.zh: 虽然这可能属实，但并非所有这些新经历都对求职有用。

fe7b226307b0700d9b343d8f4f5cdf26a40eaee5.en: Employers tend to value interpersonal skills and industry knowledge more than cultural background.
fe7b226307b0700d9b343d8f4f5cdf26a40eaee5.zh: 雇主往往更看重人际交往能力和行业知识，而非文化背景。

a4e4d5845eff0cbf307f637ec191f7d446eb0e2a.en: Electronic discourse is one form of interactive electronic communication.
a4e4d5845eff0cbf307f637ec191f7d446eb0e2a.zh: 电子话语是交互式电子通信的一种形式。

647ff5e00a6f5cba3a9a121cb0166a24a39a4ed2.en: In this study, we reserve the term for the two-directional texts in which one person using a keyboard writes language that appears on the sender's monitor and is transmitted to the monitor of a recipient, who responds by keyboard.
647ff5e00a6f5cba3a9a121cb0166a24a39a4ed2.zh: 在本研究中，我们将该术语保留用于指代双向文本：一个人使用键盘输入语言，这些内容显示在发送者的显示器上并传输到接收者的显示器，接收者再通过键盘进行回复。

4e9301897944087e4ed01e3a6a1cedda9779aaf5.en: Even though our computers are now better than 15 years ago, they still malfunction between 11 and 20 per cent of the time, a new study concludes.
4e9301897944087e4ed01e3a6a1cedda9779aaf5.zh: 一项新研究得出结论，尽管我们的计算机性能已远超15年前，但它们仍有11%至20%的时间会出现故障。

439b35a89e48e485020e4418d318557216620a6d.en: The researchers behind the study therefore find that there are major gains to be achieved for society by rethinking the systems and involving users more in their development.
439b35a89e48e485020e4418d318557216620a6d.zh: 因此，该研究的参与者认为，通过重新思考系统设计并让用户更深入地参与开发过程，社会将获得巨大的收益。

e60e09203484bd5a66dc847de04213a4403525b0.en: Exhilarating, exhausting and intense, there are just some of the words used to describe doing an MBA, everyone's experience of doing MBA is, of course, different though denying that it's hard and demanding work whichever course you do.
e60e09203484bd5a66dc847de04213a4403525b0.zh: 令人振奋、筋疲力尽且充满挑战，这些只是用来描述攻读MBA的部分词汇；当然，每个人的MBA体验各不相同，但无论修读哪门课程，都不可否认这是一项艰巨而要求极高的工作。

5a7919a86af84fc906a12d5ab6105cceee853d93.en: MBA is one of the fastest growing areas of studying in the UK so that must be a sustainable benefit against form in one pain.
5a7919a86af84fc906a12d5ab6105cceee853d93.zh: MBA是英国发展最快的学习领域之一，因此这必定是一种可持续的收益，足以抵消其带来的痛苦与不便。

0e925171a802b294b05877a3e629b1958cf49160.en: The most significant difference between an eating disorder and disordered eating is whether or not a person's symptoms and experiences align with the criteria defined by the American Psychiatric Association.
0e925171a802b294b05877a3e629b1958cf49160.zh: 进食障碍与饮食失调之间最显著的区别在于，个人的症状和经历是否符合美国精神病学协会定义的标准。

e2af62e871f3436b52528f36399020ff2a27588d.en: The term " disordered eating " is a descriptive phrase, not a diagnosis.
e2af62e871f3436b52528f36399020ff2a27588d.zh: “饮食失调”是一个描述性短语，而非诊断结果。

446d41cc182582da8061aa18d1071602e7cbbf0e.en: Australians do speak English, however, for some tourists and travellers, it can be difficult to understand the slang.
446d41cc182582da8061aa18d1071602e7cbbf0e.zh: 澳大利亚人确实说英语，但对一些游客和旅行者来说，理解俚语可能很困难。

fbff8428487f2565596231ca1c545aafdf9f34db.en: Also, the links between Australian and American English were seen to be very tenuous.
fbff8428487f2565596231ca1c545aafdf9f34db.zh: 此外，人们认为澳大利亚英语与美国英语之间的联系非常薄弱。

a40f7832aa076ce34fa94828f7aacd7dd9c1e011.en: At least some colloquialisms in Australian English do not exist in other types of English.
a40f7832aa076ce34fa94828f7aacd7dd9c1e011.zh: 澳大利亚英语中至少有一些口语表达在其他类型的英语中并不存在。

727dea70110b6be087f7fdf73f572670b1e3169c.en: Unions take the power out of the employer's hands on many issues.
727dea70110b6be087f7fdf73f572670b1e3169c.zh: 在许多问题上，工会将权力从雇主手中夺走。

6805923a32df14fcc66421db7239994af5f93eb7.en: There are examples of cases where the workers were engaging in sexual or racial harassment, but were protected by their unions and allowed to keep their jobs.
6805923a32df14fcc66421db7239994af5f93eb7.zh: 有案例显示，员工从事性骚扰或种族骚扰行为，却受到工会的保护并得以保留工作。

c997394a4a855ce408b604150cd296fda9ca09b3.en: Poor workers and excellent workers often receive the same pay and raise, giving no reason for a person to work harder than necessary at their jobs.
c997394a4a855ce408b604150cd296fda9ca09b3.zh: 表现差的员工和表现优秀的员工往往获得相同的工资和加薪，这让人没有理由在工作中付出超出必要的努力。
